XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 1. Pa gynlluniau sydd gan y Gweinidog Cabinet i wella'r gefnogaeth i ddiwydiannau creadigol Cymru? OQ64464
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 1. What plans does the Cabinet Minister have to enhance support for Wales's creative industries? OQ64464

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae gwaith ar y gweill i gyflwyno strategaeth ddiwylliant a chwaraeon newydd ar gyfer Cymru. Trwy'r strategaeth newydd, byddwn yn cydnabod bod y diwydiannau creadigol yn ganolog i fywyd diwylliannol, twf economaidd a phroffil rhyngwladol Cymru. Mi fydd Cymru Greadigol yn parhau i gefnogi talent, sgiliau, twf busnes a chyfleoedd ledled sectorau creadigol Cymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Work is under way to deliver a new culture and sport strategy for Wales. Through the new strategy, we will recognise the creative industries as central to Wales’s cultural life, economic growth and international profile. Creative Wales will continue to support talent, skills, business growth and opportunities across Wales’s creative sectors.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Minister. Creative Wales has been a magnificent success, driving growth across the creative industries for a good number of years now, and, importantly, driving up the number of decent job opportunities, particularly for young creatives in Wales. As we look towards 2029, and, hopefully, the Wrexham city of culture year, we're growing the creative industries in Wrexham and across north Wales, working with a number of institutions, including the universities that we have, like Wrexham University, and we've seen the growth in the establishment of studios, including Minera Studios in Wrexham. Minister, would you agree to visit Wrexham and meet with the leaders of the creative industries within the region, and discuss what sort of support Creative Wales can offer to turbocharge the sectors in north Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Weinidog. Mae Cymru Greadigol wedi bod yn llwyddiant ysgubol, gan sbarduno twf ar draws y diwydiannau creadigol ers sawl blwyddyn bellach, ac yn bwysig, sbarduno cynnydd yn nifer y cyfleoedd swyddi o safon, yn enwedig i bobl ifanc greadigol yng Nghymru. Wrth inni edrych tuag at 2029, sef blwyddyn Wrecsam fel dinas diwylliant, gobeithio, rydym yn tyfu'r diwydiannau creadigol yn Wrecsam ac ar draws gogledd Cymru, gan weithio gyda nifer o sefydliadau, yn cynnwys y prifysgolion sydd gennym, fel Prifysgol Wrecsam, ac rydym wedi gweld y twf o ran sefydlu stiwdios, gan gynnwys Stiwdios Minera yn Wrecsam. Weinidog, a fyddech chi'n fodlon ymweld â Wrecsam a chyfarfod ag arweinwyr y diwydiannau creadigol yn y rhanbarth, a thrafod pa fath o gymorth y gall Cymru Greadigol ei gynnig i roi hwb i'r sectorau yn y gogledd?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, yn sicr, mae gennych chi etholaeth greadigol dros ben. Roeddwn i'n falch iawn o fod yn Wrecsam ddydd Sadwrn diwethaf ar gyfer agoriad—wel, ailagor—Amgueddfa Wrecsam, ond agoriad yr amgueddfa bêl-droed, yr elfen yna. Dwi'n mynd i fod yn ymweld efo Wrecsam eto'n fuan. Dwi wedi bod yn ymgysylltu o ran UK City of Culture. Rydyn ni i gyd yn croesi'n bysedd, wrth gwrs, o ran hynny, ac fe fyddwn i'n hapus iawn i ymgysylltu efo'r Aelod. Yn sicr, mae yna bethau cyffrous iawn yn digwydd yn Wrecsam. Rydyn ni eisiau i bethau cyffrous barhau i ddigwydd yn Wrecsam, a dwi'n falch iawn i weithio efo unrhyw Aelod sy'n cynrychioli Wrecsam er mwyn cyflawni'r potensial hwnnw'n bellach.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, certainly, you have a very creative constituency. I was very pleased to be in Wrexham last Saturday for the opening—well, the reopening—of Wrexham Museum, but the opening of the football museum there, that element of it. I am going to be visiting Wrexham again soon. I have been engaging in terms of the UK City of Culture. We are all crossing our fingers, of course, in that regard, and I will be very content to engage with the Member on that. Certainly, there are very exciting things happening in Wrexham. We want exciting things to continue to happen in Wrexham, and I'm very pleased to work with any Member who represents Wrexham in order to realise that potential further.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Before I begin, can I please take the opportunity to congratulate my former colleague on her latest defection yesterday? I'm sure that her newfound political beliefs and journey to the left will have her back in the Conservative Party in no time at all.

But back to the matter at hand. Minister, Julien Macdonald is a fantastic example of the talent that can come out of Merthyr Tydfil. Born and brought up in Merthyr, he went on to work with Chanel, Givenchy, and to dress some of the biggest names in the world, including Beyoncé and Jennifer Lopez. Now, sadly, his company went into liquidation in 2023, but his success was ultimately built outside of Wales due to a lack of opportunity in the Welsh creative industry and a lack of support from Welsh Governments. So, what is the Welsh Government doing to make sure that talented people from places like Merthyr Tydfil do not feel that they have to leave to build successful creative businesses? And what support can you give to help creative companies actually base themselves in Merthyr and the wider Valleys, creating jobs and opportunities? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Cyn imi gychwyn, a gaf i fanteisio ar y cyfle i longyfarch fy nghyn gyd-Aelod ar newid plaid eto ddoe? Rwy'n siŵr y bydd ei chredoau gwleidyddol newydd a'i thaith i'r chwith yn ei harwain yn ôl i'r Blaid Geidwadol mewn dim o dro.

Ond yn ôl at y mater dan sylw. Weinidog, mae Julien Macdonald yn enghraifft wych o'r dalent a all ddod o Ferthyr Tudful. Wedi'i eni a'i fagu ym Merthyr Tudful, aeth yn ei flaen i weithio gyda Chanel, Givenchy, ac i ddylunio dillad ar gyfer rhai o'r enwau mwyaf yn y byd, gan gynnwys Beyoncé a Jennifer Lopez. Nawr, yn anffodus, cafodd ei gwmni ei ddirwyn i ben yn 2023, ond yn y pen draw, adeiladwyd ei lwyddiant y tu allan i Gymru oherwydd diffyg cyfle yn y diwydiant creadigol yng Nghymru a diffyg cymorth gan Lywodraethau Cymru. Felly, beth y mae Llywodraeth Cymru’n ei wneud i sicrhau nad yw pobl dalentog o leoedd fel Merthyr Tudful yn teimlo bod yn rhaid iddynt adael er mwyn adeiladu busnesau creadigol llwyddiannus? A pha gymorth y gallwch ei roi i helpu cwmnïau creadigol i ymsefydlu ym Merthyr Tudful a'r Cymoedd yn ehangach, gan greu swyddi a chyfleoedd? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, before you answer the question, can I just remind Members that comments like that are not appropriate in the Chamber, and that, when I'm asking you to ask a question, just to stick to what is on the script that you have provided for your question?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, cyn ichi ateb y cwestiwn, a gaf i atgoffa'r Aelodau nad yw sylwadau o'r fath yn briodol yn y Siambr, a phan fyddaf yn gofyn i chi ofyn cwestiwn, dylech gadw at yr hyn sydd ar y sgript rydych chi wedi'i darparu ar gyfer eich cwestiwn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Weinidog.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Minister.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Gaf i fod yn glir? Mae yna greadigrwydd ym mhob cornel o Gymru, ond, oherwydd diffyg cefnogaeth flaenorol, diffyg strategaeth a diffyg eglurder o ran cefnogaeth gan Lywodraeth, dydy'r potensial hwnnw ddim wastad wedi'i wireddu. Yr hyn y bydd yr Aelod wedi ei glywed yn fy ateb cychwynnol ydy ymrwymiad y Llywodraeth hon i gael strategaeth ddiwylliant iawn i Gymru, un sy'n cynnwys y diwydiannau creadigol, sy'n edrych ar sgiliau, sy'n edrych ar gyfleoedd i bobl yng Nghymru i aros yma yng Nghymru a bod yn greadigol. Dyna'r gwahaniaeth y gwelwch chi gan Lywodraeth Plaid Cymru—ein bod ni'n gwerthfawrogi'r diwydiannau creadigol, ein bod ni eisiau gweithio efo nhw, ein bod ni eisiau eu datblygu nhw a hefyd sicrhau mwy o gyfleoedd i bobl weithio mewn maes sydd o bwys economaidd mawr i'n cenedl ni.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Dirprwy Lywydd. May I be clear? There is creativity in every corner of Wales, but, because of a lack of support previously, a lack of a strategy and a lack of clarity in terms of support from Government, that potential hasn't always been realised. What the Member will have heard in my initial response is this Government's commitment to have a real culture strategy for Wales, one that includes the creative industries, that looks at skills, that looks at opportunities for people in Wales to remain here in Wales and to be creative here. That's the difference that you will see from a Plaid Cymru Government—that we appreciate the creative industries, that we want to work with them, that we want to see them develop and also want to secure more opportunities for people to work in an area that is of great economic importance to our nation.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Sir Fynwy Torfaen has played an important role in the music hall of fame. Rockfield Studios near Monmouth is where Queen recorded 'Bohemian Rhapsody', where Oasis recorded (What's the Story) Morning Glory?, and where the Manic Street Preachers recorded some of their most iconic music. It's also where Coldplay and the Super Furry Animals recorded at least their first albums. The list goes on. Opportunities for upcoming artists to record their music is limited, but they also need space to perform. That's why music venues like the Dragonffli in Pontypool are vital. They give music acts a stage to grow their audience and hone their talents. They've also hosted many iconic acts there as well. The business rates cut announced yesterday will make a massive difference to music venues, but how can the Government, via Creative Wales, support opportunities both to nurture new talent and ensure that music venues across my constituency and Wales can continue to produce world-class musicians and bands?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae Sir Fynwy Torfaen wedi chwarae rhan bwysig yn hanes cerddoriaeth. Stiwdios Rockfield ger Trefynwy yw'r fan lle recordiodd Queen 'Bohemian Rhapsody', lle recordiodd Oasis (What's the Story) Morning Glory?, a lle recordiodd y Manic Street Preachers beth o'u cerddoriaeth fwyaf eiconig. Hefyd, dyma lle recordiodd Coldplay a'r Super Furry Animals eu halbymau cyntaf. Mae'r rhestr yn parhau. Mae cyfleoedd i artistiaid newydd recordio eu cerddoriaeth yn gyfyngedig, ond mae angen lleoedd i berfformio arnynt hefyd. Dyna pam fod lleoliadau cerddoriaeth fel y Dragonffli ym Mhont-y-pŵl yn hanfodol. Maent yn rhoi llwyfan i gerddorion dyfu eu cynulleidfa a hogi eu doniau. Maent wedi cynnal perfformiadau gan lawer o berfformwyr eiconig yno hefyd. Bydd y toriad i ardrethi busnes a gyhoeddwyd ddoe yn gwneud gwahaniaeth enfawr i leoliadau cerddoriaeth, ond sut gall y Llywodraeth, drwy Cymru Greadigol, gefnogi cyfleoedd i feithrin doniau newydd ac i sicrhau y gall lleoliadau cerddoriaeth ar draws fy etholaeth i a Chymru gyfan barhau i gynhyrchu cerddorion a bandiau o'r radd flaenaf?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am y pwyntiau hynny. Mae'n hyfryd clywed am yr holl bethau gwych sy'n digwydd mewn gwahanol etholaethau. Mae Cymru Greadigol wedi cefnogi bwrsariaethau i artistiaid a chynorthwywyr cynhyrchu o Gymru i fynychu gweithdai yn Rockfield Studios, gan agor mynediad at arbenigedd y diwydiant wrth gefnogi gweithgarwch lleol a chryfhau'r ecosystem greadigol ehangach. Dwi'n credu mai'r pwynt rydych chi'n ei wneud ydy dydy pethau fel hyn ddim yn digwydd ar hap. Mae angen strategaeth, mae angen buddsoddi, mae angen cydweithio. Yr hyn rydyn ni'n ei weld ydy bod yna fandiau mawr wedi bod yn y gorffennol ond nid yw hynny'n golygu ein bod ni'n bendant yn mynd i fod â'r bandiau hynny yn y dyfodol. Mae e'n fy mhryderu i, a dwi wedi codi'r pryder yma o'r blaen, fod yna'n lai o bobl ifanc, er enghraifft, yn cymryd TGAU mewn cerddoriaeth a drama, fod yna lai o gyfleoedd a chyrsiau o ran mynd rhagddo efo cerddoriaeth, ond hefyd y cyfleoedd i berfformio, sydd yr un mor bwysig. Rydyn ni'n lwcus iawn yng Nghymru bod yna bethau fel Brwydr y Bandiau pan fo hi'n dod i Eisteddfod yr Urdd a'r Genedlaethol ac ati. Mae'r rhain yn rhoi cyfleoedd. Ond, yn sicr, fel rhan o strategaeth hirdymor o ran cerddoriaeth, mae'n rhaid i ni fod yn meithrin talent newydd a chreu y seilwaith yna. Fel rydych chi'n sôn, mae cyhoeddiad ddoe yn mynd i fod yn help o ran lleoliadau lle mae cerddoriaeth fyw yn digwydd. Mae'n rhaid i ni barhau i weithio'n agos gyda phethau fel y Music Venue Trust er mwyn sicrhau bod dyfodol pwysig iddyn nhw.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for those points. It's lovely to hear about all those excellent things that are happening in different constituencies. Creative Wales has supported bursaries for artists and production assistants from Wales to attend Rockfield Studios workshops, opening up access to expertise in the industry while supporting local activity and strengthening the creative ecosystem more broadly. I think the point that you make is that things like this don't happen by chance. You need a strategy, you need investment, you need collaboration. What we're seeing is that there have been major bands in the past but it doesn't mean that we're definitely going to have those bands in the future. It does concern me, and I have raised this concern previously, that there are fewer young people, for example, taking GCSE drama and music, that there are fewer opportunities and courses in terms of carrying on with music, but also opportunities to perform, which are just as important. We're very lucky in Wales that we have things like Battle of the Bands when it comes to the Urdd Eisteddfod and the National Eisteddfod and so on. These provide opportunities. But certainly, as part of the long-term strategy in terms of music, we have to nurture new talent and we have to create that infrastructure. As you mentioned, the announcement yesterday will help live music venues. We need to continue to work closely with things like the Music Venue Trust in order to ensure that there is an important future for them.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 2. Pa drafodaethau y mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet wedi'u cael gyda chyrff llywodraethu chwaraeon ynghylch diogelu plant a phobl ifanc sy'n cymryd rhan mewn chwaraeon ar lawr gwlad? OQ64436
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 2. What discussions has the Cabinet Minister had with sport governing bodies about safeguarding children and young people participating in grass-roots sport? OQ64436

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Chwaraeon Cymru, ar ran Llywodraeth Cymru, yn gweithio'n agos gyda chyrff llywodraethu, clybiau a darparwyr chwaraeon cymunedol i hyrwyddo polisïau, hyfforddiant a gweithdrefnau diogelu cadarn. Mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn disgwyl i'r holl gyrff llywodraethu chwaraeon gymryd diogelu o ddifrif, gweithredu'n brydlon ar bryderon, a sicrhau bod plant a phobl ifanc yn gallu cymryd rhan yn ddiogel.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Sport Wales, on behalf of the Welsh Government, works closely with governing bodies, clubs and community sport providers to promote robust safeguarding policies, training and procedures. The Welsh Government expects all organisations delivering sport to take safeguarding seriously, to act promptly on concerns, and to ensure that children and young people can participate safely.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Minister. Volunteer coaches and committee members in communities across north Wales, including Flintshire and Wrexham, give up their evenings and weekends to give our young people fantastic opportunities. I know this because I've been involved in grass-roots sport for a long time. Yet they are increasingly drowning in red tape while struggling to access timely safeguarding training and DBS checks. What concrete practical support and funding is your department providing directly to grass-roots clubs to ensure robust safeguarding does not become an insurmountable administrative barrier that forces local clubs to close? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Weinidog. Mae hyfforddwyr gwirfoddol ac aelodau pwyllgorau mewn cymunedau ledled gogledd Cymru, gan gynnwys sir y Fflint a Wrecsam, yn rhoi eu nosweithiau a'u penwythnosau i ddarparu cyfleoedd gwych i'n pobl ifanc. Rwy'n gwybod hyn am fy mod wedi bod yn ymwneud â chwaraeon llawr gwlad ers amser maith. Ac eto maent yn boddi mewn mwy a mwy o fiwrocratiaeth wrth frwydro i gael mynediad at hyfforddiant diogelu amserol a gwiriadau DBS. Pa gymorth ymarferol pendant a chyllid y mae eich adran chi yn ei ddarparu'n uniongyrchol i glybiau llawr gwlad i sicrhau nad yw mesurau diogelu cadarn yn dod yn rhwystr gweinyddol anorchfygol sy'n gorfodi clybiau lleol i gau? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Llywodraeth Cymru wedi bod yn cydweithio efo Llywodraethau eraill ledled y Deyrnas Unedig. Roedd yna adroddiad prosiect ar chwaraeon diogel a gyhoeddwyd yn 2025. Comisiynwyd hwn ar ôl ymgynghoriad helaeth efo cyrff llywodraethu, cynghorau chwaraeon, athletwyr a phobl sydd â phrofiad byw. Chwaraeon Cymru sy'n cynrychioli Cymru o ran y gwaith hwn. Mi wnes i, yn fy nghyfarfod rhynglywodraethol cyntaf efo Gweinidogion chwaraeon eraill y Deyrnas Unedig, drafod hyn yn Glasgow yng Ngemau'r Gymanwlad. Mae hwn yn fater o bwys. Mae o'n fater sydd ddim dim ond yn berthnasol i Gymru. Yn amlwg, fe fyddaf yn sicrhau bod y gwaith hwnnw'n mynd rhagddo. Wrth gwrs, os oes yna unrhyw Aelod yn ymwybodol o le mae yna bryderon, mae'n ddyletswydd arnom i gyd fod yn adrodd ar hynny ac mi fyddwn i yn annog unrhyw un i sicrhau hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welsh Government has been working together with other Governments across the United Kingdom. There was a 'Safe Sport Project Report' that was published in 2025. This was commissioned after intensive engagement with governing bodies, sport councils, athletes and people who have lived experience. Sport Wales represents Wales in terms of that work. In our first intergovernmental meeting as sport Ministers from all parts of the United Kingdom, we discussed this in Glasgow during the Commonwealth Games. This is an important issue. It is an issue that is not just relevant to Wales. Obviously, I will make sure that that work goes forward. Of course, if any Member is aware of any concerns, then we all have a responsibility to report on that and I would encourage anyone to make sure that that happens.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Like Nigel and many parents across Wales, I spend much of my weekends on sidelines across my constituency, and I want to give a heartfelt thanks to all of our dedicated coaches across Wales, because grass-roots sport wouldn't exist without those hard-working volunteers. Sport clubs must be an environment where young people build friendships and they improve their mental and physical well-being. Young women in particular are more likely to become leaders when they participate in team sport. But too many young people are prevented from accessing these clubs because of the associated costs: kit, boots, fees, even getting to games. So, Cabinet Minister, I'd like to ask how you will ensure that governing bodies promote accessible pathways to participation so that every child can access the lifelong benefits of grass-roots sport.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fel Nigel a llawer o rieni ledled Cymru, rwy'n treulio llawer o fy mhenwythnosau ar ystlysau ar draws fy etholaeth, a hoffwn ddiolch o galon i'n holl hyfforddwyr ymroddedig ledled Cymru, gan na fyddai chwaraeon llawr gwlad yn bodoli heb y gwirfoddolwyr gweithgar hynny. Rhaid i glybiau chwaraeon fod yn amgylchedd lle mae pobl ifanc yn meithrin cyfeillgarwch ac yn gwella eu lles meddyliol a chorfforol. Mae menywod ifanc yn arbennig yn fwy tebygol o ddod yn arweinwyr pan fyddant yn cymryd rhan mewn chwaraeon tîm. Ond mae gormod o bobl ifanc yn cael eu rhwystro rhag cael mynediad at y clybiau hyn oherwydd y costau cysylltiedig: citiau, esgidiau chwaraeon, ffioedd, cyrraedd gemau hyd yn oed. Felly, Weinidog Cabinet, hoffwn ofyn sut y byddwch chi'n sicrhau bod cyrff llywodraethu yn hyrwyddo llwybrau hygyrch i gyfranogiad fel y gall pob plentyn gael mynediad at fanteision gydol oes chwaraeon llawr gwlad.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am godi'r pwyntiau pwysig hynny. Yn ganolog i holl weledigaeth y Llywodraeth hon, o ran chwaraeon a diwylliant, mae sicrhau cyfranogiad i bawb a dim rhwystrau. Mae hwnna'n rhan o'n galwad ni am dystiolaeth ar y funud, sydd ar agor tan 19 Rhagfyr, felly plîs a wnaiff pawb annog pobl i gyflwyno tystiolaeth, oherwydd rydyn ni'n gwybod bod yna rhwystrau'n bodoli ar y funud. Rydych chi wedi crybwyll rhai ohonyn nhw, ond mae yna eraill. Os ydym ni eisiau i bawb gael y cyfleodd hynny, yna, dwi yn cytuno efo'r Aelod, mae'n rhaid gweithredu. Felly, dwi'n mawr obeithio, yn dod allan o'r strategaeth ddiwylliant a chwaraeon newydd yma, y bydd sicrhau cyfranogiad i bawb yn rhan ganolog o hynny, a chydweithio efo Gweinidogion eraill, gan gynnwys y Gweinidog addysg a'r Gweinidog dros gyfiawnder cymdeithasol hefyd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for raising those important points. Central to the whole vision of this Government in relation to sport and culture is ensuring participation for all without barriers. That is part of our call for evidence at the moment, which will be open until the 18 December, so please encourage people to present evidence to that because we know that barriers exist. You've mentioned some of them, but there are others too. If we want everyone to have those opportunities, then, I agree with the Member, we must take action. So, I very much hope that, coming out of the new culture and sports strategy, ensuring participation for all will be a central part of the strategy, and I will be working with other Ministers, including the Minister for education and the Minister for social justice too.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I now call on the party spokespeople to question the Cabinet Minister. The Reform UK spokesperson, Louise Emery.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cabinet Minister, thank you for coming to the culture committee on Monday, where we discussed the shadow broadcasting and communications authority for Wales. I'd like to press you further on this, if I may. You referred in committee to the 2023 expert panel report as evidence for supporting your approach to this shadow authority. As a lot of us weren't there in 2023, I thought I'd just remind us of the remit of that panel. The main purpose was to provide options and recommendations on the delivery of the Welsh Government and Plaid Cymru co-operation agreement at the time to explore the creation of this shadow authority. The panel will have specific regard to that and will be expected to build on that initial thinking within the co-operation agreement. So, it may well have been an expert panel, but I'm not sure it was independent advice given. So, I'd like to ask the Minister what independent assessment your Government has undertaken of the alternative—that the problems identified by the panel, which we both agree on, could be addressed within the existing UK regulatory framework without any need for a shadow authority.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog Cabinet, diolch am ddod i'r pwyllgor diwylliant ddydd Llun, lle buom yn trafod awdurdod darlledu a chyfathrebu cysgodol i Gymru. Hoffwn eich holi ymhellach ar hyn, os caf. Fe gyfeirioch chi yn y pwyllgor at adroddiad y panel arbenigol yn 2023 fel tystiolaeth i gefnogi eich cynlluniau ar gyfer yr awdurdod cysgodol hwn. Gan nad oedd llawer ohonom yno yn 2023, roeddwn yn meddwl y buaswn yn atgoffa ein hunain o gylch gwaith y panel hwnnw. Y prif bwrpas oedd darparu opsiynau ac argymhellion ar gyflawni cytundeb cydweithio Llywodraeth Cymru a Phlaid Cymru ar y pryd i archwilio'r syniad o greu'r awdurdod cysgodol hwn. Bydd y panel yn rhoi sylw penodol i hynny, a disgwylir iddo adeiladu ar y syniadau cychwynnol hynny yn y cytundeb cydweithio. Felly, mae'n bur debyg ei fod yn banel arbenigol, ond nid wyf yn siŵr a oedd y cyngor a roddwyd yn annibynnol. Felly, hoffwn ofyn i'r Gweinidog pa asesiad annibynnol y mae eich Llywodraeth wedi'i wneud o'r dewis arall—y gellid mynd i'r afael â'r problemau a nodwyd gan y panel, problemau yr ydym ein dwy yn cytuno arnynt, o fewn fframwaith rheoleiddio presennol y DU heb unrhyw angen am awdurdod cysgodol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Dwi ddim yn gwybod os ydy fy swyddogion i wedi cael cyfle i rannu gyda'r pwyllgor eto yr ystod o dystiolaeth roeddwn i'n cyfeirio ato fo yn ystod fy sesiwn ateb cwestiynau. Mi wnes i gyfeirio at adroddiad yr IWA, yr Institute of Welsh Affairs, a oedd yn annibynnol a ddim wedi'i gomisiynu gan Lywodraeth. Mi wnes i gyfeirio at ymchwil academaidd sydd hefyd ddim wedi'i gomisiynu gan Lywodraeth. Mae yna ystod o dystiolaeth eang yma. Mi oedd y gwaith a wnaed o ran y cytundeb cydweithio yn deillio o hynny.

Mi fyddwn i hefyd yn annog Aelodau i edrych ar waith a wnaed yn ystod y pumed Senedd gan y pwyllgor rydych chi rŵan yn aelod ohono fo a ddangosodd yn drawsbleidiol, ddim gan y Llywodraeth—. Roedd yn waith craffu gan Aelodau blaenorol o'r Senedd hon a oedd yn cadarnhau nad yw darlledu yn gweithio i Gymru fel ag y mae o ac yn annog bod angen i'r Llywodraeth weithredu. Felly, yr hyn dwi'n ei wneud fel Gweinidog ydy gweithredu ar argymhellion annibynnol—yn gweithredu a gwrando—a dyna dwi'n gobeithio buasai unrhyw Weinidog yn ei wneud yn fy sefyllfa i.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I don't know if my officials have had an opportunity to share with the committee yet the range of evidence that I referred to during my question session with the committee. I referred to the IWA report, the Institute of Welsh Affairs, which was independent and was not commissioned by Government. I referred to academic research that was also not commissioned by Government. There is a broad range of evidence out there. The work done in terms of the co-operation agreement emerged from that.

I would also encourage Members to look at the work done during the fifth Senedd by the committee that you're now a member of, which, on a cross-party basis, not from Government, was scrutiny work carried out by previous Members of this Senedd that confirmed that broadcasting isn't working for Wales as it currently stands, and encouraged Government to take action. So, what I'm doing as a Minister is acting on independent recommendations—listening and acting—and that's what I hope that any Minister would do in my position.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for that answer, and, as I think we agree, nobody disputes that journalism faces financial pressures, particularly in Wales, that viewing habits are changing and that Welsh language broadcasting should definitely be supported. And I refer to the Welsh Affairs Committee, which heard evidence from S4C in the last week or so, working successfully with the BBC, Ofcom and the Department for Culture, Media and Sport to improve the prominence of Welsh language content and address these problems. None of these discussions stated that devolution was the best outcome. Referring to our committee discussion, we talked about the need for funding for extra journalists particularly. So, do you believe that, if this goes ahead as, obviously, a shadow authority, ultimately devolving broadcasting powers to Cardiff would actually mean funding available to solve these problems, and where would this money come from? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am eich ateb, ac fel y credaf ein bod yn cytuno, nid oes unrhyw un yn gwadu bod newyddiaduraeth yn wynebu pwysau ariannol, yn enwedig yng Nghymru, fod arferion gwylio yn newid, ac yn sicr, fod angen cefnogi darlledu yn yr iaith Gymraeg. Ac rwy'n cyfeirio at y Pwyllgor Materion Cymreig, a glywodd dystiolaeth gan S4C yn yr wythnos ddiwethaf, gan weithio'n llwyddiannus gyda'r BBC, Ofcom a'r Adran dros Ddiwylliant, y Cyfryngau a Chwaraeon i wella amlygrwydd cynnwys Cymraeg a mynd i'r afael â'r problemau hyn. Ni ddywedodd yr un o'r trafodaethau hyn mai datganoli oedd y canlyniad gorau. Gan gyfeirio at drafodaeth ein pwyllgor, buom yn trafod yr angen am gyllid ar gyfer newyddiadurwyr ychwanegol yn arbennig. Felly, os bydd hyn yn digwydd, a ydych chi'n credu, fel awdurdod cysgodol, yn amlwg, y byddai datganoli pwerau darlledu i Gaerdydd yn y pen draw yn golygu y byddai cyllid ar gael i ddatrys y problemau hyn, ac o ble fyddai'r arian hwn yn dod? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dwi'n credu, a byddwn i'n gobeithio bod pob Aelod yma yn credu, y dylem ni gael llais yma yng Nghymru ac y dylai penderfyniadau ynglŷn â Chymru gael eu gwneud yng Nghymru. Mae'r ffaith nad oes gennym ni lais fel Llywodraeth o ran yr hyn sy'n digwydd o ran siarter y BBC ar y funud, ein bod ni'n cael ein hymgynghori fel y mae unrhyw unigolyn yng Nghymru, ac nad oes gennym ni lais yn anghyfiawnder—bod dyfodol S4C yn ddibynnol ar benderfyniadau mewn Senedd sydd ddim yma yng Nghymru, heb unrhyw angen i gymryd ystyriaeth eich barn chi o ran craffu na fy marn innau fel Gweinidog. Dydy o ddim yn gweithio. Dyna pam mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn mynd ati i edrych ar y dystiolaeth o ran sefydlu awdurdod darlledu a chyfathrebu cysgodol, er mwyn edrych ar sut y byddai'n gweithio yma yng Nghymru. Gwneud y gwaith caib a rhaw i fynd i'r afael â phroblemau—dyna ydy bwriad hwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I believe, and I would hope that every Member would agree, that we in Wales should have a voice and that decisions on Wales should be made in Wales. The fact that we don't have a voice as a Government in relation to what's happening in terms of the BBC charter at the moment, that we are consulted with just as any individual in Wales would be, and that we don't have a voice, really is unjust—that the future of S4C is reliant on decisions being taken in a Parliament that isn't here in Wales, without any need to take into account your views in terms of scrutiny, or my views as a Minister. It simply isn't working. That's why this Government is looking at the evidence in terms of establishing a shadow broadcasting and communications authority, to look at how it would work here in Wales. Doing that preparatory work to tackle problems—that's the intention of this.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: A final question, and I'll change the subject now. Minister, the closure of the listed places of worship grant scheme has left congregations facing significant extra costs. In June, I think I spoke about this and you promised an update on Cadw's assessment of the closure's impacts and confirmed that Wales did receive Barnett consequentials. Three months on, we have over 3,000 listed places of worship in Wales still without dedicated support. Scotland has launched a scheme. What has that assessment concluded and will you commit to protecting Wales's historic churches and chapels?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Un cwestiwn olaf, ac rwyf am newid y pwnc. Weinidog, mae cau'r cynllun grant mannau addoli rhestredig wedi golygu bod cynulleidfaoedd yn wynebu costau ychwanegol sylweddol. Ym mis Mehefin, rwy'n credu imi sôn am hyn, ac fe wnaethoch chi addo rhoi diweddariad ar asesiad Cadw o effeithiau'r cau a chadarnhau bod Cymru wedi derbyn cyllid canlyniadol Barnett. Dri mis yn ddiweddarach, mae gennym dros 3,000 o fannau addoli rhestredig yng Nghymru heb gymorth pwrpasol o hyd. Mae'r Alban wedi lansio cynllun. Beth yw casgliad yr asesiad hwnnw ac a wnewch chi ymrwymo i ddiogelu eglwysi a chapeli hanesyddol Cymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Fel y gwnes i eich ateb chi pan wnaethoch chi godi hwn y tro diwethaf, mae yna gefnogaeth wedi bod, yn ariannol, gan Cadw tuag at addoldai. Mi rydyn ni wedi bod yn gwneud y gwaith pellach. Mae yna gyngor ar ei ffordd i fi. Unwaith dwi wedi ystyried hwnnw, mi fydd y wybodaeth yna yn cael ei rannu gyda'r holl Aelodau o ran y camau nesaf. Ond i fod yn glir, mae yna gyllid wedi bod yn cael ei roi i gefnogi addoldai—ddim yr un math o gyllid, ond mi fyddaf yn ystyried y cyngor a ddaw ger fy mron i yn fuan iawn. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: As I responded to your previous question on this, there has been some financial support from Cadw for places of worship. We have been doing further work, and there is advice on its way to me. Once I've considered that advice, that information will be shared with all Members in terms of the next steps. But just to be clear, funding has been delivered to support places of worship—not the same kind of funding, but I will consider the advice that I will receive very soon. Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd Llafur Cymru, Mike Hedges.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welsh Labour spokesperson, Mike Hedges.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. First of all, can I declare an interest as a member of Seion Newydd chapel? Following on from the question that was asked a few moments ago, Wales is home to some of the most significant historic churches and chapels in Europe. These buildings are not only places of worship; they are centres of community life, landmarks of Welsh history, and an essential part of our cultural inheritance. The withdrawal of the listed places of worship grant scheme has removed about £1 million a year that helped congregations maintain these nationally important buildings, placing additional pressure on communities already struggling to meet rising repair costs. Now that this funding has been lost, do you agree that Wales should establish its own replacement scheme to ensure that our priceless Welsh heritage receives the support it needs for future generations?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Yn gyntaf oll, a gaf i ddatgan buddiant fel aelod o gapel Seion Newydd? Yn dilyn y cwestiwn a ofynnwyd ychydig eiliadau yn ôl, mae Cymru’n gartref i rai o'r eglwysi a'r capeli hanesyddol mwyaf arwyddocaol yn Ewrop. Nid mannau addoli yn unig yw'r adeiladau hyn; maent yn ganolfannau bywyd cymunedol, yn dirnodau hanes Cymru, ac yn rhan hanfodol o'n hetifeddiaeth ddiwylliannol. Mae diddymu'r cynllun grant mannau addoli rhestredig wedi dileu oddeutu £1 filiwn y flwyddyn a oedd yn cynorthwyo cynulleidfaoedd i gynnal yr adeiladau hyn sydd o bwys cenedlaethol, gan roi pwysau ychwanegol ar gymunedau sydd eisoes yn ei chael hi'n anodd talu costau atgyweirio cynyddol. Gan fod y cyllid hwn wedi'i golli bellach, a ydych chi'n cytuno y dylai Cymru sefydlu ei chynllun newydd ei hun i sicrhau bod ein treftadaeth Gymreig amhrisiadwy yn cael y cymorth sydd ei angen arni ar gyfer cenedlaethau'r dyfodol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Cadw yn ymgysylltu yn weithredol ag enwadau ffydd a chynrychiolwyr y sector i ddeall yn well cyflwr mannau addoli hanesyddol a'r pwysau ehangach y mae nhw'n eu hwynebu, gan gynnwys ffabrig sy'n heneiddio, defnydd sy'n newid, cynulleidfaoedd sy'n gostwng, costau cynnal a chadw, a mynediad at sgiliau arbenigol. Mae Cadw yn parhau i ddarparu cymorth uniongyrchol drwy ei raglenni grant ei hun. Dros y pum mlynedd diwethaf, mae yna fwy na £2 filiwn o gyllid grant adeiladau hanesyddol Cadw wedi cefnogi mannau addoli, sy'n cynrychioli tua 20 y cant o'r gyllideb grantiau. Mi fyddwch chi hefyd wedi clywed fy ymateb i i'r Aelod blaenorol. Dwi yn disgwyl cyngor pellach o ran hyn, ac mi fyddaf yn rhannu diweddariad unwaith dwi wedi derbyn hwnnw.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Cadw does engage proactively with faith communities and the sector to understand better the state of our buildings of worship and the pressures that they face, including ageing fabrics, change in use, declining congregations, maintenance costs, and access to skills. Cadw continues to provide direct support through its own grant schemes. Over the past five years, more than £2 million of Cadw historic building grants have supported places of worship, which represents almost 20 per cent of grant funding. You will have also heard my response to the previous Member. I do expect further advice and guidance on this, and I will share an update once I've received that.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for that. Wales has a long and diverse religious history. We have many famous religious buildings, including Anglican churches, Catholic churches, nonconformist chapels, mosques, Sikh temples, Buddhist temples, synagogues and Hindu temples. I request that the Minister considers two actions: firstly, that a feasibility study on the creation of a museum on religions in Wales is carried out; and secondly that, working with other Cabinet colleagues, the Welsh Government creates a religious tourism plan. Whilst local tour plans exist, I cannot find a complete tour plan, and we've got a number of very important religious buildings, not only in Swansea.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Mae gan Gymru hanes crefyddol hir ac amrywiol. Mae gennym lawer o adeiladau crefyddol enwog, gan gynnwys eglwysi Anglicanaidd, eglwysi Catholig, capeli anghydffurfiol, mosgiau, temlau Sikhaidd, temlau Bwdhaidd, synagogau a themlau Hindŵaidd. Gofynnaf i'r Gweinidog ystyried dau gam gweithredu: yn gyntaf, fod astudiaeth ddichonoldeb yn cael ei chynnal ar gyfer creu amgueddfa ar gyfer y crefyddau yng Nghymru; ac yn ail, fod Llywodraeth Cymru, gan weithio gyda chyd-Aelodau eraill o'r Cabinet, yn creu cynllun twristiaeth grefyddol. Er bod cynlluniau teithiau lleol yn bodoli, ni allaf ddod o hyd i gynllun teithiau cyflawn, ac mae gennym nifer o adeiladau crefyddol pwysig iawn, ac nid yn Abertawe'n unig.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiynau hynny. Mae'r ffaith ein bod ni yn ymgynghori ar y funud o ran strategaeth ddiwylliant a chwaraeon newydd, a'n bod ni yn edrych yn strategol, yn gyfle perffaith i bob Aelod yma i fod yn annog etholwyr, i fod yn annog unrhyw gymdeithasau, ac Aelodau eu hunain, i fod yn cyfrannu syniadau tuag at y strategaeth honno. Felly, byddwn ni yn eich annog chi i gyflwyno'r syniadau hyn, a byddwn ni wedyn yn gallu edrych ar yr holl ystod o bethau yr hoffai pobl yng Nghymru ein gweld ni'n buddsoddi ynddyn nhw. Un peth y byddwn i yn ei ddweud yw eich bod chi'n berffaith iawn i fod yn cydnabod pwysigrwydd cymaint o'n haddoldai ni, a'r amrywiaeth a'r stori mae nhw'n ei ddweud ynglŷn â Chymru. Felly, diolch i chi am godi'r pwyntiau hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for those questions. The fact that we are consulting at the moment in terms of a new culture and sports strategy, and that we are looking strategically, is the perfect opportunity for every Member here to encourage constituents, to suggest to any societies, and Members themselves, to contribute ideas to that strategy. So, I would encourage you all to put forward these ideas, and we will then be able to look at the entire range of things that people in Wales would like to see us investing in. The one thing that I would say is that you are quite right to recognise the importance of so many of our places of worship, and the range of them that there is, and the story that they tell about Wales. So, thank you for raising those points.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd y Ceidwadwyr Cymreig, Paul Davies.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welsh Conservatives spokesperson, Paul Davies.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Cabinet Minister, this summer has showcased some amazing international athletics. For the first time ever, the European Athletics Championships came to Great Britain, and there was, of course, the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, which provided another opportunity to celebrate sporting excellence, with Team Wales delivering a strong performance and finishing ninth overall. I'm sure you'll join me in congratulating our athletes and coaches on their achievements and the pride they have brought here to Wales. Given the success of these major sporting events, and the benefits that they bring in terms of participation, economic investment and international profile, can you tell us what the Welsh Government is doing to attract major sporting events to Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Weinidog Cabinet, rydym wedi gweld athletau rhyngwladol anhygoel dros yr haf. Am y tro cyntaf erioed, daeth Pencampwriaethau Athletau Ewrop i Brydain, a chynhaliwyd Gemau'r Gymanwlad yn Glasgow wrth gwrs, a oedd yn gyfle arall i ddathlu rhagoriaeth chwaraeon, gyda Thîm Cymru’n perfformio'n gryf ac yn dod yn nawfed. Rwy'n siŵr y gwnewch chi ymuno â mi i longyfarch ein hathletwyr a'n hyfforddwyr ar eu cyflawniadau a'r balchder y maent wedi'i ddwyn yma i Gymru. O ystyried llwyddiant y digwyddiadau chwaraeon mawr hyn, a'r manteision y maent yn eu darparu o ran cyfranogiad, buddsoddiad economaidd a phroffil rhyngwladol, a allwch chi ddweud wrthym beth y mae Llywodraeth Cymru’n ei wneud i ddenu digwyddiadau chwaraeon mawr i Gymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Dwi bendant yn cytuno efo chi. Mi oeddwn i'n falch iawn o dîm Cymru, ac nid dim ond y rhai a enillodd y medalau; mi oedd yna berfformiadau rhagorol yna, ac mi ddylem ni fod yn falch iawn o'r holl dîm. Fel roeddwn i'n sôn gerbron y pwyllgor, pan oeddwn i yn Glasgow, roedd gweld bod Cymru wedi creu cymaint o argraff, eu bod nhw'n ail hoff dîm pawb nad oeddent o Gymru, yn sicr wedi bod yn wych i'w weld. Yn amlwg, mi oedd yna newyddion trist iawn dros yr haf hefyd, ac mi fyddwn i'n hoffi cymryd y cyfle yma i sôn am Fin Tarling. Mae ein meddyliau ni i gyd efo'i deulu a'i ffrindiau. Roedd hynny'n drychinebus dros yr haf.

O ran ein strategaeth ni rŵan, dwi eisiau sicrhau, o ran digwyddiadau mawr—. Roeddwn i'n falch iawn ddoe ein bod ni wedi gweld bod Champions League y menywod yn dod i Gymru yn 2029. Dwi'n falch i ddweud mai un o fy mhenderfyniadau i fel Gweinidog oedd cefnogi hwnna, ac mae hwnna'n dangos ein bod ni'n gweithredu. Ond dwi wedi bod yn glir iawn hefyd fod yn rhaid i'r holl ddigwyddiadau mawr rydyn ni'n mynd amdanyn nhw fod i bwrpas a'n bod ni wedi ystyried, cyn ein bod ni'n ymgeisio, beth fydd y buddsoddiad, ond hefyd beth ydy'r gwerth yn economaidd, yn gymdeithasol a'r deilliannau o ran hynny.

Mi ydych chi a minnau wedi bod yma yn y gorffennol a gweld Llywodraethau efallai'n methu â dweud beth ydy'r mesurau, sut rydyn ni'n mesur llwyddiant, ac mae hwnna'n sicr yn rhywbeth dwi'n edrych arno rŵan fel Gweinidog o ran y Tour de France a hefyd Ewros 2028. Ond mi ddylai'r mesurau yna fod yn eu lle cyn inni fod yn ymgeisio, a syniad o beth rydyn ni eisiau cael allan ohonyn nhw. Felly, mi ydyn ni'n ailedrych ar y strategaeth digwyddiadau mawr hefyd, ac mi fydda i'n mynd â'r gwaith yma rhagddo. Mae gwaith wedi dechrau, ond rydyn ni'n mynd â hwnna ymhellach hefyd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I certainly agree with you. I was very proud of Team Wales, and not just those that won the medals; there were some wonderful and excellent performances, and we should be extremely proud of the whole team. As I mentioned in my appearance before the committee, when I was in Glasgow, to see that Wales had made such am impression, that they were everyone's second favourite team for everyone who wasn't from Wales, was wonderful to see. Clearly, there was some very sad news over the summer too, and I would like to take this opportunity to mention Fin Tarling. Our thoughts are with his friends and family. That was a disastrous occurrence over the summer.

In terms of our strategy now, I do want to ensure, in terms of major events—. I was very pleased yesterday that we saw that the UEFA Women's Champions League was to come to Wales in 2029. I'm pleased to say that that was one of my decisions as a Minister to support that, and that shows that we are taking action. But I have been very clear, too, that all major events that we bid for have to be for a purpose and that we will have considered, before making a bid, what the investment would be, but also what the value will be economically, socially, and outcomes in relation to that.

You and I have been here in the past and have seen Governments perhaps failing to outline what success looks like, and that is certainly something that I'm looking at now in relation to the Tour de France and also the 2028 Euros. But those measures and yardsticks should be in place before we bid, and we should have an idea of what we want to achieve. So, we are reviewing the major events strategy, and I will be taking that work forward. The work has commenced, but we will take it further.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm grateful for that response. Of course, at the other end of the spectrum, it's vital that the Welsh Government is building a pipeline of sporting talent, and that, of course, means investing in sports facilities across the country. The financial challenges facing the sports sector are well known, and if the Welsh Government is serious about creating legacies from major sporting events, then the sector will need more funding. Your party's own manifesto commits to increasing funding for culture and sport year on year throughout this Senedd term. So, Cabinet Minister, can you provide a guarantee to the culture and sports sector that they will receive a real-terms increase in the upcoming draft budget and every other year under this Government? Can you also provide an update on your audit of community and regional sporting facilities, so that we can better understand where capital investment needs to be targeted going forward?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n ddiolchgar am eich ymateb. Wrth gwrs, ar ben arall y sbectrwm, mae'n hanfodol fod Llywodraeth Cymru’n adeiladu llif o dalent mewn chwaraeon, ac mae hynny, wrth gwrs, yn golygu buddsoddi mewn cyfleusterau chwaraeon ledled y wlad. Mae'r heriau ariannol sy'n wynebu'r sector chwaraeon yn dra hysbys, ac os yw Llywodraeth Cymru o ddifrif ynglŷn â chreu gwaddol o ddigwyddiadau chwaraeon mawr, bydd angen mwy o gyllid ar y sector. Mae maniffesto eich plaid eich hun yn ymrwymo i gynyddu cyllid ar gyfer diwylliant a chwaraeon flwyddyn ar ôl blwyddyn drwy gydol tymor y Senedd hon. Felly, Weinidog Cabinet, a allwch chi roi gwarant i'r sector diwylliant a chwaraeon y byddant yn derbyn cynnydd mewn termau real yn y gyllideb ddrafft sydd ar y ffordd ac ym mhob blwyddyn arall o dan y Llywodraeth hon? A allwch chi roi'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf i ni hefyd am eich archwiliad o gyfleusterau chwaraeon cymunedol a rhanbarthol, fel y gallwn ddeall yn well ble mae angen targedu buddsoddiad cyfalaf yn y dyfodol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'm glad that the Member referenced the work that we've prioritised in terms of understanding the need, because the thing that I'm determined to do is have a plan in place long term, because, as I said in evidence to the committee, we do know, in some sectors, the investments needed, and the figures are eye-watering. They're not the kind of finances that we have currently available, they're nowhere near enough what's needed, and we will need to look strategically once we know that full picture.

I completely agree with you—and I think I mentioned this in my response to Mike Hedges during committee on Monday, when he asked me about bidding for the Commonwealth Games—we can't just invest in facilities to attract major events if then it means there's no money left to invest in key infrastructure like our swimming pools, like 3G pitches and so on, and that means that people in your constituency, in other constituencies across Wales, then fail to have access. So, this work will then be able to outline what investment is needed, where public investment is needed, how we work with local authorities, work with different budgets, because there are investments made in schools, for instance, in sport facilities.

The guarantee I give you is that we will have that long-term strategic approach, working with national governing bodies, Sport Wales, working with local authorities, working across portfolios, to ensure that we identify where the gaps are, where infrastructure is at point of failure as well, because we know a number of swimming pools are extremely old across Wales and are at risk of not being financially viable or able to stay open. We know some have closed already. That's my commitment. We want to see the right facilities that people will be able to use so they can stay active, be active in their communities, and that means every corner of Wales, rural Wales, including urban.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n falch fod yr Aelod wedi cyfeirio at y gwaith rydym wedi'i flaenoriaethu o ran deall yr angen, gan mai'r hyn rwy'n benderfynol o'i wneud yw cael cynllun ar waith yn hirdymor, oherwydd fel y dywedais mewn tystiolaeth i'r pwyllgor, fe wyddom faint o fuddsoddiad sydd ei angen mewn rhai sectorau, ac mae'r ffigurau'n syfrdanol. Nid yw'r math hwn o gyllid ar gael gennym ar hyn o bryd, nid yw'n agos at yr hyn sydd ei angen, a bydd angen inni edrych yn strategol pan fyddwn yn ymwybodol o'r darlun llawn hwnnw.

Rwy'n cytuno'n llwyr—ac rwy'n credu imi sôn am hyn yn fy ymateb i Mike Hedges yn y pwyllgor ddydd Llun, pan ofynnodd i mi ynglŷn ag ymgeisio am Gemau'r Gymanwlad—ni allwn fuddsoddi mewn cyfleusterau i ddenu digwyddiadau mawr os yw hynny'n golygu wedyn nad oes arian ar ôl i fuddsoddi mewn seilwaith allweddol fel ein pyllau nofio, fel caeau 3G ac yn y blaen, gan olygu bod pobl yn eich etholaeth, mewn etholaethau eraill ledled Cymru, yn methu cael mynediad. Felly, bydd y gwaith hwn wedyn yn gallu amlinellu pa fuddsoddiad sydd ei angen, ble mae angen buddsoddiad cyhoeddus, sut rydym yn gweithio gydag awdurdodau lleol, yn gweithio gyda gwahanol gyllidebau, gan fod buddsoddiadau'n cael eu gwneud mewn ysgolion, er enghraifft, mewn cyfleusterau chwaraeon.

Y warant rwy'n ei rhoi i chi yw y bydd gennym y dull strategol hirdymor hwnnw, gan weithio gyda chyrff llywodraethu cenedlaethol, Chwaraeon Cymru, gan weithio gydag awdurdodau lleol, gan weithio ar draws portffolios, i sicrhau ein bod yn nodi ble mae'r bylchau, lle mae seilwaith bron â methu hefyd, gan y gwyddom fod nifer o byllau nofio ledled Cymru yn hen iawn ac mewn perygl o ddod yn ariannol anhyfyw neu fethu aros ar agor. Gwyddom fod rhai eisoes wedi cau. Dyna fy ymrwymiad i. Rydym am weld y cyfleusterau iawn y bydd pobl yn gallu eu defnyddio fel y gallant aros yn egnïol, bod yn egnïol yn eu cymunedau, ac mae hynny'n golygu pob cornel o Gymru, y Gymru wledig ac ardaloedd trefol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mi wnes i gwrdd â chynrychiolwyr o Undeb Rygbi Cymru ym mis Awst a thrafod eu cynlluniau ar gyfer dyfodol y gêm broffesiynol. Fe wnes i wneud yn glir bwysigrwydd ymgysylltu agored ac ystyrlon gyda rhanbarthau, cefnogwyr a chymunedau, a sicrhau bod unrhyw benderfyniadau yn dryloyw, yn seiliedig ar dystiolaeth ac yn ystyried yr effaith ehangach ar rygbi Cymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I met WRU representatives in August and discussed their plans for the future of the professional game. I made clear the importance of open and meaningful engagement with regions, supporters and communities, and of ensuring that any decisions are transparent, evidence based and take full account of the wider impact on Welsh rugby.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Grass-roots clubs should be at the heart of the Welsh Rugby Union's decision making. The decision to drop either the Ospreys or the Scarlets will be devastating for communities across south-west Wales. As someone from Ystradgynlais, for example, I would say that, if you were to tell me that there was no longer to be a local derby between Ystradgynlais and Ystalyfera, there might be some form of civil disorder, even. This is a decision of much graver consequences, as it used to be said, in the Swansea valley at least, that there were two places of worship for the Welsh people and it was debatable whether it was chapel or the rugby pitch that was the most culturally significant.

The Ospreys' and Scarlets' success is known across Europe, with both teams also heavily contributing to Wales's international success. The people demand, rightfully, and deserve transparent answers, as you say, from the Welsh Rugby Union, which they've not been given. As we've seen too frequently in south Wales, when industry leaves—and this is a form of industry—nothing takes its place. Does the Minister agree that the Welsh Rugby Union should provide the transparency, accountability and collaboration on how they got to their decision to drop either the Ospreys or the Scarlets? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Dylai clybiau llawr gwlad fod wrth wraidd penderfyniadau Undeb Rygbi Cymru. Bydd y penderfyniad i gael gwared ar naill ai'r Gweilch neu'r Scarlets yn ddinistriol i gymunedau ledled y de-orllewin. Fel rhywun o Ystradgynlais, er enghraifft, buaswn yn dweud, pe baech chi'n dweud wrthyf na fyddai gornest leol rhwng Ystradgynlais ac Ystalyfera mwyach, gallai arwain at ryw fath o derfysg sifil hyd yn oed. Mae hwn yn benderfyniad ag iddo ganlyniadau llawer mwy difrifol, gan mai'r hyn yr arferwyd ei ddweud, yng nghwm Tawe o leiaf, oedd bod dau le i bobl Cymru addoli, ac roedd yn destun dadl ai'r capel neu'r cae rygbi oedd y mwyaf arwyddocaol yn ddiwylliannol.

Mae'r Gweilch a'r Scarlets yn enwog ledled Ewrop am eu llwyddiant, gyda'r ddau dîm hefyd yn cyfrannu'n helaeth at lwyddiant rhyngwladol Cymru. Mae'r bobl, yn gywir ddigon, yn mynnu ac yn haeddu atebion tryloyw, fel y dywedwch, gan Undeb Rygbi Cymru, ac nid ydynt wedi'u cael. Fel y gwelsom yn rhy aml yn ne Cymru, pan fo diwydiant yn gadael—ac mae hwn yn fath o ddiwydiant—nid oes unrhyw beth yn cymryd ei le. A yw'r Gweinidog yn cytuno y dylai Undeb Rygbi Cymru ddarparu'r tryloywder, yr atebolrwydd a'r cydweithrediad ar sut y gwnaethant y penderfyniad i gael gwared ar naill ai'r Gweilch neu'r Scarlets? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: A gaf i ddiolch i'r Aelod, yn gyntaf, am y cyfathrebu rydych chi wedi'i wneud efo fi dros y pwnc yma, ynghyd â'ch Aelodau chi dros Ŵyr Abertawe, a hefyd i bob Aelod sydd wedi ymgysylltu efo fi dros y mater pwysig hwn? Mae rygbi yn fwy na champ, onid ydy? Mae pobl yn ei deimlo fo i'r byw; mae o'n rhan o hunaniaeth cymunedau, fel rydych chi wedi sôn fan hyn. Mae'r tryloywder yna'n bwysig, oherwydd mae hyn am fwy na lleoliad, mae'n fwy nag effaith economaidd; mae ynglŷn â'r ymdeimlad cymunedol yna. Felly, yn sicr, fel y gwnes i ddweud yn fy ymateb cychwynnol, mi ddywedais i'n glir wrth Undeb Rygbi Cymru ein bod ni'n disgwyl y tryloywder yna, ein bod ni'n disgwyl y cydweithio efo cymunedau, a dyna fy neges i eto heddiw.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Can I thank the Member, in the first instance, for the communication that you've had with me on this topic, as well as your fellow Members for Gŵyr Abertawe, and also every Member who has contacted me on this important matter? Rugby is more than just a sport, isn't it? People feel it to the quick. It's part of the identity of communities, as you have mentioned here. And that transparency is important, because this is about more than just a location, it's more than just the economic impact; it's about that community spirit and feeling. So certainly, as I said in my initial answer, I said very clearly to the WRU that we do expect transparency, we expect that collaboration with communities, and that's my message again today.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'd like to start by saying thank you to the Member for raising the question, and apologise because I think it's in the same vein. But Minister, the Welsh Rugby Union recently wrote to me and told me why it is cutting four professional clubs to three. What it has not told me in that letter is why the metric used differs from one part of Wales to another.

In the east and the capital, geography settled it, quite clearly. Cardiff and Newport were each given their own licence area, and the incumbents were confirmed. No competition, no scoring, no test of merit. The WRU's own letter to me confirms that the factors weighted most heavily there were population, accessibility and infrastructure. Performance and pathways came second. So, in summary, geography decided two of the licences, and merit was only demanded in determining the third spot. The most damning indictment of this decision in that correspondence is that the two clubs already chosen are our worst performing with regard to silverware, and the two being asked to fight out the remaining spot, the Scarlets and the Ospreys, are the two most successful clubs in the modern Welsh rugby era.

If, as the WRU state, the intention of this exercise is to ensure that Welsh rugby is once again a force in the game at regional and international levels, then it is quite at odds with the fact that the two clubs being asked to determine their eligibility for the third spot have produced more internationals than either Cardiff or Newport. So, will the Cabinet Secretary join me in calling for the WRU to finally publish the evidence and the scoring decisions that have brought us to this stage?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Hoffwn ddechrau drwy ddiolch i'r Aelod am godi'r cwestiwn, ac ymddiheuro am fy mod yn credu ei fod i'r un perwyl. Ond Weinidog, ysgrifennodd Undeb Rygbi Cymru ataf yn ddiweddar a dweud wrthyf pam eu bod yn lleihau'r nifer o glybiau proffesiynol o bedwar i dri. Yr hyn na ddywedodd wrthyf yn y llythyr hwnnw yw pam y mae'r metrig a ddefnyddir yn wahanol rhwng un rhan o Gymru a'r llall.

Yn y dwyrain a'r brifddinas, fe'i gwnaed, yn eithaf clir, ar sail daearyddiaeth. Rhoddwyd ardal drwydded eu hunain i Gaerdydd a Chasnewydd, a chadarnhawyd y rheini. Dim cystadleuaeth, dim sgorio, dim prawf teilyngdod. Mae llythyr Undeb Rygbi Cymru eu hunain ataf yn cadarnhau mai'r ffactorau pwysicaf yno oedd poblogaeth, hygyrchedd a seilwaith. Roedd perfformiad a llwybrau yn dod yn ail. Felly, i grynhoi, daearyddiaeth a bennodd ddwy o'r trwyddedau, a dim ond wrth bennu'r drydedd yr ystyriwyd teilyngdod. Y cyhuddiad mwyaf damniol o'r penderfyniad hwn yn yr ohebiaeth honno yw mai'r ddau glwb sydd eisoes wedi'u dewis yw ein perfformwyr gwaethaf o ran tlysau, a'r ddau sy'n gorfod ymladd am y lle sy'n weddill, y Scarlets a'r Gweilch, yw'r ddau glwb mwyaf llwyddiannus yn oes fodern rygbi Cymru.

Os mai bwriad yr ymarfer hwn, fel y mae Undeb Rygbi Cymru’n ei ddatgan, yw sicrhau bod rygbi Cymru yn gryf unwaith eto ar lefelau rhanbarthol a rhyngwladol, mae hynny'n anghydnaws â'r ffaith bod y ddau glwb sy'n gorfod ymladd am y trydydd safle wedi cynhyrchu mwy o chwaraewyr rhyngwladol na Chaerdydd neu Gasnewydd. Felly, a wnaiff Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet ymuno â mi wrth alw ar Undeb Rygbi Cymru i gyhoeddi'r dystiolaeth a'r penderfyniadau sgorio sydd wedi ein harwain at y cam hwn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for raising those concerns. It is essential that this process is conducted in a way that is transparent, evidence-based, and accountable. Supporters, players, volunteers, local communities and elected Members must have confidence that decisions are being taken with a full understanding of the wider impact and that their views have been properly considered. In any subsequent conversations with the Welsh Rugby Union—I do meet with them regularly—I will, of course, express the views that have been expressed to me.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am godi'r pryderon hynny. Mae'n hanfodol fod y broses hon yn cael ei chynnal mewn ffordd sy'n dryloyw, yn seiliedig ar dystiolaeth, ac yn atebol. Rhaid i gefnogwyr, chwaraewyr, gwirfoddolwyr, cymunedau lleol ac Aelodau etholedig fod yn hyderus fod penderfyniadau'n cael eu gwneud gyda dealltwriaeth lawn o'r effaith ehangach a bod eu barn wedi'i hystyried yn briodol. Mewn unrhyw sgyrsiau dilynol gydag Undeb Rygbi Cymru—rwy'n cyfarfod â nhw'n rheolaidd—byddaf yn sicr o fynegi'r safbwyntiau a fynegwyd i mi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
