XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 4. What is the Welsh Government doing to support the development of a professional rugby team in north Wales? OQ64432

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Fel dwi wedi amlinellu eisoes heddiw, mae Undeb Rygbi Cymru yn gorff llywodraethu annibynnol ar gyfer rygbi yng Nghymru ac mae'n gyfrifol am benderfyniadau ynghylch strwythur a datblygiad y gêm broffesiynol, gan gynnwys yng ngogledd Cymru. Nid yw Llywodraeth Cymru yn ariannu timau chwaraeon proffesiynol, ond trwy Chwaraeon Cymru rydyn ni yn cefnogi'r gymuned a'r gêm ar lawr gwlad.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: As I've already outlined this afternoon, the WRU is the independent governing body for rugby in Wales and is responsible for decisions about the structure and development of the professional game, including in north Wales. The Welsh Government does not fund professional sports teams, but through Sport Wales we support the community and the grass-roots game.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. A hundred and twenty-one million people worldwide watched the 2023 six nations championship across 209 international territories. Six nations matches regularly attract UK television audiences of up to 4.5 million viewers. Welsh rugby generates an estimated £225 million to £250 million annually through the professional game and match-day activity. An independent study commissioned by the Welsh Rugby Union found that Principality Stadium contributes £2.75 billion in economic output and supported around 2,500 jobs annually. 

Now, despite this, there does remain a clear imbalance in the professional game. Professional men's rugby has long been concentrated in Cardiff, Swansea, Llanelli and Newport, leaving north Wales without a professional regional team. As the WRU moves towards a three-region model, there are concerns that opportunities for supporters and talented young players in north Wales could be further diminished. How exactly are you going to redress this inequality?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Gwyliodd 121 miliwn o bobl ledled y byd bencampwriaeth y chwe gwlad yn 2023 ar draws 209 o diriogaethau rhyngwladol. Mae gemau'r chwe gwlad yn denu cynulleidfaoedd teledu o hyd at 4.5 miliwn o wylwyr yn y DU yn rheolaidd. Mae rygbi Cymru yn cynhyrchu rhwng £225 miliwn a £250 miliwn yn flynyddol, yn ôl amcangyfrifon, drwy'r gêm broffesiynol a gweithgareddau diwrnod gêm. Canfu astudiaeth annibynnol a gomisiynwyd gan Undeb Rygbi Cymru fod Stadiwm Principality yn cyfrannu £2.75 biliwn o allbwn economaidd ac yn cynnal tua 2,500 o swyddi bob blwyddyn.

Er hynny, mae anghydbwysedd clir yn parhau yn y gêm broffesiynol. Mae rygbi proffesiynol i ddynion wedi'i ganoli ers amser maith yng Nghaerdydd, Abertawe, Llanelli a Chasnewydd, gan adael gogledd Cymru heb dîm rhanbarthol proffesiynol. Wrth i Undeb Rygbi Cymru symud tuag at fodel tri rhanbarth, mae pryderon y gallai cyfleoedd i gefnogwyr a chwaraewyr ifanc dawnus yng ngogledd Cymru gael eu lleihau ymhellach. Sut yn union rydych chi'n bwriadu mynd i'r afael â'r anghydraddoldeb hwn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Fel gwnes i ddweud yn fy ymateb cyntaf, Undeb Rygbi Cymru ydy'r corff llywodraethu annibynnol a nhw sydd efo'r cyfrifoldeb, ond mae gen i, wrth gwrs, gyfleoedd yn fy nghyfarfodydd gyda nhw i fynegi unrhyw bryderon sy'n cael eu codi gyda ni.

O ran rygbi gogledd Cymru, dwi yn cydnabod yr uchelgais gref a'r cyfranogiad rygbi cynyddol ledled gogledd Cymru, a dwi'n cefnogi datblygiad y gêm ar bob lefel. Mi ydyn ni eisiau i chwaraewyr talentog o ogledd Cymru gael llwybrau clir i gyrraedd lefelau uchaf y gêm o fewn eu cymunedau, heb orfod symud o ogledd Cymru. A dwi wedi darllen y pryderon nad ydy hynny'n bosib ar y funud, felly diolch i'r Aelod am godi hynna gyda fi.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
As I said in my initial response, it's the WRU that is the independent governing body and they have responsibility in this area, but, of course, I do have opportunities in my meetings with them to express any concerns that have been raised with me.

In terms of rugby in north Wales, I do recognise the strong ambition and the increasing popularity of and participation in rugby in north Wales, and I support the development of the game at all levels. We want talented players from north Wales to have clear pathways to get to the elite levels of the game within their communities, without having to move from north Wales. I have read concerns that this isn't currently possible, so I thank the Member for raising the issue with me.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you to the Minister for her answers so far and to Janet for bringing this question forward. Minister, when I look across my constituency, I see a wealth of great rugby clubs, whether that's Colwyn Bay, Denbigh, Mold, Ruthin, Rhyl, to name just some. Their squads, staff and supporters show every week the important role that rugby plays across Clwyd and across Wales. However, when speaking to these teams and others, I'm told that young talent is often scouted and drawn across into English rugby pathways. The former Wales captain Jon Davies is right, we need to provide a pathway for Welsh rugby into Welsh rugby regions and the national side.

You promised in the manifesto to prioritise equality of access to sport. In response, you've called for evidence for a report that'll come in the spring, but what can you do in the meantime to take action with national and regional stakeholders to help create pathways for local talent to have access to national and regional rugby clubs here in Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch i'r Gweinidog am ei hatebion hyd yma ac i Janet am gyflwyno'r cwestiwn hwn. Weinidog, wrth edrych ar fy etholaeth, gwelaf nifer o glybiau rygbi gwych, ym Mae Colwyn, Dinbych, yr Wyddgrug, Rhuthun neu'r Rhyl, i enwi rhai ohonynt yn unig. Mae eu carfannau, eu staff a'u cefnogwyr yn dangos bob wythnos y rôl bwysig y mae rygbi'n ei chwarae ar draws Clwyd ac ar draws Cymru. Fodd bynnag, wrth siarad â'r timau hyn ac eraill, dywedir wrthyf fod talent ifanc yn aml yn cael ei sgowtio a'i ddenu draw i lwybrau rygbi Lloegr. Mae cyn-gapten Cymru, Jon Davies, yn iawn: mae angen i ni ddarparu llwybr ar gyfer rygbi Cymru i mewn i ranbarthau rygbi Cymru ac i'r tîm cenedlaethol.

Fe wnaethoch chi addo yn y maniffesto y byddech yn blaenoriaethu mynediad cyfartal at chwaraeon. Mewn ymateb, rydych chi wedi galw am dystiolaeth ar gyfer adroddiad a fydd yn cael ei gyhoeddi yn y gwanwyn, ond beth allwch chi ei wneud yn y cyfamser i weithredu ar y cyd â rhanddeiliaid cenedlaethol a rhanbarthol i helpu i greu llwybrau i dalent leol gael mynediad at glybiau rygbi cenedlaethol a rhanbarthol yma yng Nghymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. Fel oeddwn i'n dweud, nid cyfrifoldeb Llywodraeth Cymru mo hynny, ond yn sicr mi fyddwn ni eisiau cydweithio efo Undeb Rygbi Cymru a gwahanol gyrff llywodraethu eraill o ran mynediad cyfartal i chwaraeon. O ran y pwyntiau dŷch chi'n eu codi, mi fyddwn i'n argymell eich bod chi'n eu codi nhw hefyd efo Undeb Rygbi Cymru yn uniongyrchol. Mae'n bwysig ein bod ni yn gweithredu ar ran etholwyr o ran clybiau lleol. Ond yn sicr, fel dywedais i wrth Janet Finch-Saunders, dŷn ni eisiau cyfleoedd i bobl ifanc allu parhau yma yng Nghymru i chwarae ar y lefel uchaf, a dŷn ni'n cydnabod nad yw hynny yn digwydd ar y funud.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. As I mentioned, this isn't the responsibility of Welsh Government, but, certainly, we would want to work with the WRU and different governing bodies in terms of equal access to sport. In terms of the points that you raise, I would suggest that you also raise them with the WRU directly. It is important that we do act in the interests of constituents in terms of local clubs, But, certainly, as I told Janet Finch-Saunders, we certainly want opportunities for young people to remain here in Wales and to play at the highest levels, and we recognise that that isn't currently happening.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn cefnogi cyfranogiad rygbi yng Nghlwyd drwy ein buddsoddiad mewn chwaraeon ar lawr gwlad, a ddarperir drwy Chwaraeon Cymru. Mae hyn yn helpu clybiau i wella cyfleusterau, lleihau costau rhedeg a chreu mwy o gyfleoedd i bobl o bob oed a chefndir gymryd rhan.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Welsh Government supports rugby participation in Clwyd through our investment in grass-roots sport, delivered through Sport Wales. This helps clubs improve facilities, reduce running costs and create more opportunities for people of all ages and backgrounds to take part.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thanks very much indeed. Minister, as you know, rugby is deeply rooted in communities across Clwyd, as my colleague just alluded, in Colwyn Bay, Rhyl and District, Denbigh, Flint, Ruthin, Mold. We have a number of clubs across the region. Communities across Wales's participation in grass-roots rugby is not only beneficial to players but gives a vital outlet for socialisation and channels investment into local economies, which is particularly important. Restructuring cannot simply be dismissed as an internal matter for the WRU, of course. Sport Wales provides £430,000 of public funding to the WRU, while millions more are invested through Actif North Wales. So, against a background of structural shifts being made within the WRU, what assurances can the Minister give that north Wales will not be starved of the community benefits of Wales's national game? And will she commit to ensuring that public funding protects grass-roots rugby and genuine player pathways for young people in Clwyd?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr. Weinidog, fel y gwyddoch, mae rygbi wedi'i wreiddio'n ddwfn mewn cymunedau ledled Clwyd, fel y nododd fy nghyd-Aelod, ym Mae Colwyn, y Rhyl a'r cylch, Dinbych, y Fflint, Rhuthun, yr Wyddgrug. Mae gennym nifer o glybiau ledled y rhanbarth. Mae cyfranogiad cymunedau ledled Cymru mewn rygbi llawr gwlad nid yn unig yn fuddiol i chwaraewyr, mae'n darparu mannau hanfodol ar gyfer cymdeithasu ac yn sianelu buddsoddiad i economïau lleol, sy'n arbennig o bwysig. Ni ellir diystyru ailstrwythuron yn syml fel mater mewnol i Undeb Rygbi Cymru wrth gwrs. ​​Mae Chwaraeon Cymru yn darparu £430,000 o gyllid cyhoeddus i Undeb Rygbi Cymru, tra bod miliynau’n fwy'n cael ei fuddsoddi trwy Gogledd Cymru Actif. Felly, yn erbyn cefndir o newidiadau strwythurol sy'n cael eu gwneud o fewn Undeb Rygbi Cymru, pa sicrwydd y gall y Gweinidog ei roi na chaiff gogledd Cymru ei amddifadu o fanteision cymunedol gêm genedlaethol Cymru? Ac a wnaiff hi ymrwymo i sicrhau bod cyllid cyhoeddus yn diogelu rygbi llawr gwlad a llwybrau go iawn i chwaraewyr ifanc yng Nghlwyd?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Nid Llywodraeth Cymru sy'n penderfynu ar y buddsoddiad hwnnw. Mae e'n fater i gyrff chwaraeon unigol ond hefyd i Chwaraeon Cymru. Yr hyn sydd gennym ni fel ymrwymiad fel Llywodraeth ydy ein bod ni eisiau sicrhau bod yna fuddsoddiad ledled Cymru, cyfle i bawb gyfranogi lle bynnag eu bod yn byw yng Nghymru. Ac mae'r adolygiad strategol dŷn ni'n ei wneud o ran lle mae angen buddsoddiad yn cydweithio gydag Undeb Rygbi Cymru, Cymdeithas Pêl-droed Cymru, Nofio Cymru ac eraill i sicrhau bod hwnnw'n gynllun sy'n cael ei gefnogi gan bawb, nid dim ond gan y Llywodraeth ond gan y cyrff hyn hefyd. Bydd yna waith hefyd i weithio efo awdurdodau lleol o ran hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: It's not the Welsh Government that decides on that investment. It's a matter for the individual sports bodies but also for Sport Wales. What we have made as a commitment as a Government is that we want to ensure that there is investment across Wales and an opportunity for everyone to participate wherever they live in Wales. And the strategic review that we're carrying out in terms of where investment is needed works together with the WRU, FAW, Swim Wales and others to ensure that that is a plan that is supported by everyone, not just by the Government but by these bodies as well. Work will also be done to work with local authorities in terms of that too.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: For reasons including fear of judgment, feeling unsafe, inadequate facilities and a lack of role models, more than a third of girls drop out of grass-roots rugby during their teenage years. While there has been some welcome improvement, there remains a significant gap in retention rates compared with boys' teams, and there's a clear under-representation on boards. Gender equality is not just about participation, but also recognition and support in line with male counterparts. What measures will the Government take to reshape perceptions, promote greater equality and improve the retention of girls in rugby?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Am resymau sy’n cynnwys ofn cael eu barnu, teimlo'n anniogel, cyfleusterau annigonol a diffyg modelau rôl, mae mwy na thraean o ferched yn rhoi'r gorau i rygbi llawr gwlad yn ystod eu harddegau. Er y bu rhywfaint o welliant calonogol, mae bwlch sylweddol o hyd yn y cyfraddau sy’n dal ati o'i gymharu â thimau bechgyn, ac mae’n amlwg nad oes cynrychiolaeth ddigonol ar fyrddau. Mae cydraddoldeb rhwng y rhywiau yn ymwneud â mwy na chyfranogiad yn unig. Mae a wnelo hefyd â chydnabyddiaeth a chefnogaeth sy’n cymharu â’r hyn a roddir i’w cymheiriaid gwrywaidd. Pa fesurau fydd y Llywodraeth yn eu mabwysiadu i ail-ffurfio canfyddiadau, i hyrwyddo mwy o gydraddoldeb ac i wella’r niferoedd o ferched sy’n dal ati i chwarae rygbi?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch am godi'r pwyntiau pwysig yna. Wrth gydweithio gydag Undeb Rygbi Cymru dŷn ni eisiau sicrhau—. Fel roeddwn i'n dweud, mae'n bwysig iawn fod pawb yn cael y cyfle i gyfranogi, a phan mae yna rwystrau i hynny, yna mae hwnna'n her dwi'n barod iawn i'w rhoi i Undeb Rygbi Cymru neu ei rhoi i unrhyw gorff lle nad yw hynny'n gweithio.

Mae peth data yn dangos bod yna beth newydd da o ran merched yng Nghymru. Mae 90 y cant o chwaraewyr rŵan yn symud o'r pathway dan 14 i dan 16 o ran rygbi, sydd yn gam pwysig yn ei flaen. Ond, yn amlwg, mae angen deall wedyn beth arall sydd angen cael ei wneud, ac mae hwn yn rhywbeth byw iawn o ran trafodaethau rhwng swyddogion, Undeb Rygbi Cymru a holl gyrff chwaraeon yng Nghymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you for raising those important points. Working with the WRU, we want to ensure—. As I said, it's very important that everyone has the opportunity to participate, and when there are barriers to that, then that is a challenge that I am ready to put to the WRU or to put to any body where that isn't working as it should.

There is some data that shows that there is some good news in terms of women and girls in Wales. Some 90 per cent of players now move from the under-14 pathway to that for under-16s in terms of rugby, which is an important step forward. But, obviously, we then need to understand what else needs to be done, and this is something that's very live to us in terms of discussions between officials and the WRU and all of the sporting bodies in Wales.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 6. Sut mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn cefnogi cyfleusterau llyfrgell yng Nghasnewydd Islwyn? OQ64455
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 6. How is the Welsh Government supporting library facilities in Casnewydd Islwyn? OQ64455

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Llywodraeth Cymru'n cefnogi cyfleusterau llyfrgell yng Nghasnewydd Islwyn drwy gyllid cyfalaf a refeniw ar gyfer datblygu llyfrgelloedd. Mae hyn yn cynnwys £200,000 o gyllid cyfalaf i drawsnewid y llyfrgell i blant yn Llyfrgell Ganolog Casnewydd. Mae llyfrgelloedd Casnewydd Islwyn hefyd wedi elwa o dros £22,000 ar gyfer cyllid prosiectau grantiau bach.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Welsh Government supports library facilities in Casnewydd Islwyn through capital and revenue funding for the development of libraries. This includes £200,000 in capital funding to transform the children's library in Newport Central Library. Libraries in Casnewydd Islwyn have also benefited from over £22,000 for small grant project programmes.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: People are rightly concerned as to why valued libraries and leisure facilities have been allowed to disappear. Will the Cabinet Minister work with councils and Sport Wales to ensure that, before any facilities are closed and lost forever, the community is given the evidence, available alternatives and genuine opportunity to retain them through community ownership or genuine like-for-like replacement provision?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae pobl yn pryderu, yn briodol ddigon, pam y caniatawyd i lyfrgelloedd a chyfleusterau hamdden gwerthfawr ddiflannu. A wnaiff y Gweinidog Cabinet weithio gyda chynghorau a Chwaraeon Cymru i sicrhau, cyn i unrhyw gyfleusterau gael eu cau a'u colli am byth, fod y gymuned yn cael y dystiolaeth, y dewisiadau amgen sydd ar gael a chyfle go iawn i'w cadw drwy berchnogaeth gymunedol neu ddarpariaeth gyfatebol ddilys yn eu lle?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Dŷch chi'n codi pwynt pwysig dros ben, a does gen i ddim y pwerau i ymyrryd yn y fath fodd, ond yr hyn yr ydw i'n ei wneud ar y funud, trwy'r gwaith dŷn ni'n ei wneud, ydy deall beth yw'r sefyllfa o ran llyfrgelloedd ledled Cymru. Maen nhw'n wasanaeth statudol. Dŷn ni'n gwybod bod yna doriadau wedi bod ledled Cymru. Mae nifer o Aelodau yma wedi ymgyrchu o ran ceisio cadw llyfrgelloedd lleol ar agor, a dwi yn poeni yn fawr ynglŷn â dyfodol ein llyfrgelloedd ni—y dyfodol o ran y buddsoddiad hwnnw.

Mae angen inni ddeall beth ydy'r sefyllfa, a dyna pam, o ran cael gweledigaeth a strategaeth hirdymor a bod yn glir o ran y buddsoddiad hirdymor sydd ei angen, y medraf roi'r sicrwydd i'r Aelod fy mod i'n credu bod llyfrgelloedd yn bwysig, bod y gwaith hwn yn digwydd, ac mi fyddwn ni eisiau gweithio gydag awdurdodau lleol, yn sicr, er mwyn sicrhau bod y gwasanaethau iawn yn ein cymunedau ni a bod yna fynediad i'n llyfrgelloedd ni.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
You raise an extremely important point, and I don't have the powers to intervene in that manner, but what I am doing at the moment, through the work that we are doing, is to understand what the situation actually is in terms of libraries the length and breadth of Wales. They're a statutory service. We know that there have been cuts across Wales. Many Members here will have campaigned to retain their local libraries, and I am deeply concerned about the future of our libraries—the future in terms of that investment.

We need to understand what the situation is, and that is why, in terms of a long-term vision and strategy and to be clear on the long-term investment needed, I can give an assurance to the Member that I do believe that libraries are important, that this work is ongoing, and that we would want to work with local authorities, certainly, in order to ensure that the right services exist in our communities and that there is access to our libraries.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae'r gwaith o lunio strategaeth diwylliant a chwaraeon newydd i Gymru yn digwydd ar y funud, ac mae treftadaeth a diwylliant cyfoethog ein cenedl yn rhan ganolog o hyn. Mae gennym ni weledigaeth glir ynghylch datblygu Cymru i fod yn bwerdy diwylliant a chwaraeon. Rydyn ni wedi ymrwymo i wireddu hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Work in relation to a new culture and sports strategy for Wales is happening at the moment, and heritage and the rich culture of our nation are a central part of that. We have a clear vision in terms of developing Wales to be a cultural and sporting powerhouse. We have committed to realising that.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you. Trefnydd, the Government is committed to the decolonisation of Welsh history, but this represents an attack on Welsh identity. The British empire was ultimately a force for good in the world, and the Welsh played an important role in bringing technology, education, common law, democracy, and Christian ideals, such as the primacy of truth and the dignity of individual human life, to peoples and cultures with no such previous concepts. Indeed, without British colonisation, the institution of slavery would have continued across the globe unabated. Rather than decolonising history, we should just tell it honestly, and that would mean conceding that, during the period of colonisation, the conscience of the British empire was the most morally sophisticated the world has ever known.

Trefnydd, will you agree that using contemporary moral standards to judge the empire that actually had to formulate those moral standards first-hand, because they didn't exist previously, is not only bad historical practice, it shows immense ingratitude to those who gave us the ideas that we now take for granted?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Drefnydd, mae'r Llywodraeth wedi ymrwymo i ddad-drefedigaethu hanes Cymru, ond mae hyn yn ymosodiad ar hunaniaeth Gymreig. Yn y pen draw, roedd yr ymerodraeth Brydeinig yn rym er lles yn y byd, ac fe chwaraeodd y Cymry ran bwysig yn dod â thechnoleg, addysg, cyfraith gyffredin, democratiaeth, a delfrydau Cristnogol, megis uchafiaeth y gwirionedd ac urddas bywyd dynol, i bobloedd a diwylliannau heb gysyniadau blaenorol o'r fath. Yn wir, heb drefedigaethu Prydeinig, byddai caethwasiaeth wedi parhau ar draws y byd heb ei leihau. Yn hytrach na dad-drefedigaethu hanes, dylem ddweud y gwir yn onest, a byddai hynny'n golygu cyfaddef, dros gyfnod y trefedigaethu, mai cydwybod yr ymerodraeth Brydeinig oedd y mwyaf moesol soffistigedig yn y byd erioed.

Drefnydd, a wnewch chi gytuno bod defnyddio safonau moesol cyfoes i farnu'r ymerodraeth y bu'n rhaid iddi lunio'r safonau moesol hynny drosti ei hun am nad oeddent yn bodoli o'r blaen, nid yn unig yn arfer hanesyddol gwael, mae'n dangos anniolchgarwch aruthrol i'r rhai a roddodd i ni'r syniadau rydym bellach yn eu cymryd yn ganiataol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Can I be very clear? I disassociate myself with every single comment made and, no, I do not agree with the Member.

I would suggest that the Member takes the time to speak to people that he represents, who will be horrified and frightened by some of the comments made. I would also ask him to be mindful that our different cultural organisations are governed—our museums, for instance—by a code of ethics, and they are working ethically. And that's what I ask of any institution that receives public funding—to work within the ethics in which they are bound, to be respectful, to be mindful, as we are bound by a Members' code of conduct to do so.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
A gaf i fod yn glir iawn? Rwy'n datgysylltu fy hun oddi wrth bob un o'r sylwadau a wnaed a na, nid wyf yn cytuno â'r Aelod.

Carwn awgrymu bod yr Aelod yn rhoi amser i siarad â'r bobl y mae'n eu cynrychioli, a fyddai'n arswydo ac yn dychryn wrth glywed rhai o'r sylwadau a wnaed. Hoffwn ofyn iddo fod yn ymwybodol hefyd fod ein gwahanol sefydliadau diwylliannol yn cael eu llywodraethu—ein hamgueddfeydd, er enghraifft—gan god moesegol, ac maent yn gweithio'n foesegol. A dyna rwy'n ei ofyn gan unrhyw sefydliad sy'n derbyn cyllid cyhoeddus—i weithio o fewn y foeseg y maent yn rhwym iddi, i fod yn barchus, i fod yn ystyriol, fel rydym ninnau wedi ein rhwymo gan god ymddygiad yr Aelodau i'w wneud.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae digwyddiadau chwaraeon fel pencampwriaethau dan-19 UEFA yn gyfleoedd pwerus a phwysig i ysbrydoli pobl ifanc ac annog mwy o gyfranogiad mewn chwaraeon. Mi fyddwn yn gweithio gyda phartneriaid, gan gynnwys Cymdeithas Bêl-droed Cymru a Sefydliad Pêl-droed Cymru, i adeiladu ar y momentwm o'r twrnamaint trwy gefnogi pêl-droed ar lawr gwlad, gwella mynediad at gyfleusterau a chryfhau cysylltiadau rhwng ysgolion, clybiau a chymunedau.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Sporting events such as the UEFA under-19 championships are powerful and important opportunities to inspire young people and to encourage greater participation in sport. We will work with partners, including the Football Association of Wales and the Cymru Football Foundation, to build on the momentum of the tournament by supporting grass-roots football, improving access to facilities and strengthening links between schools, clubs and communities.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for your response, Cabinet Minister. Before the recess, I was pleased to be able to highlight, in this Chamber, that the championships were taking place in north Wales over the summer. And it was a huge success, hosted at four different locations across north Wales, including the very own Racecourse ground in my own constituency of Fflint Wrecsam.

But just before the tournament ended, the four chief medical officers of Wales, England, Scotland and Northern Ireland came together to release a new physical activity guidelines report that encourages children and young people to engage in 60 minutes per day of physical activity, such as sports. And I'm sure you'd agree that engaging in that physical activity benefits our physical and mental health and can certainly relieve pressures in our NHS, and it's just better for people in the long run. So, I wonder how you see your role, in working with the Minister responsible for our health services, to ensure that children are encouraged to take part in sports activities. And I wonder also whether you reflect on the Member's Bill that I raised in this Senedd last term, which was seeking to encourage more young people to engage in outdoor activities, and whether there's any opportunity to review any of the work that took place in the last Senedd term on outdoor activities for children in schools.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am eich ymateb, Weinidog Cabinet. Cyn y toriad, roeddwn yn falch o allu nodi, yn y Siambr hon, fod y pencampwriaethau'n cael eu cynnal yng ngogledd Cymru dros yr haf. Ac roedd yn llwyddiant ysgubol, wedi'i gynnal mewn pedwar lleoliad gwahanol ar draws gogledd Cymru, gan gynnwys y Cae Ras yn fy etholaeth i yn Fflint Wrecsam.

Ond ychydig cyn i'r bencampwriaeth ddod i ben, daeth pedwar prif swyddog meddygol Cymru, Lloegr, yr Alban a Gogledd Iwerddon at ei gilydd i gyhoeddi adroddiad newydd ar ganllawiau gweithgarwch corfforol sy'n annog plant a phobl ifanc i gymryd rhan mewn 60 munud y dydd o weithgarwch corfforol, fel chwaraeon. Ac rwy'n siŵr y byddech chi'n cytuno bod cymryd rhan yn y gweithgarwch corfforol hwnnw o fudd i'n hiechyd corfforol a meddyliol ac y gall leddfu pwysau yn ein GIG, ac yn syml, ei fod yn well i bobl yn y tymor hir. Felly, tybed sut rydych chi'n gweld eich rôl chi, wrth weithio gyda'r Gweinidog sy'n gyfrifol am ein gwasanaethau iechyd, i sicrhau bod plant yn cael eu hannog i gymryd rhan mewn gweithgareddau chwaraeon. Tybed hefyd a ydych chi'n rhoi sylw i'r Bil Aelod a godais yn y Senedd y tymor diwethaf, a oedd yn ceisio annog mwy o bobl ifanc i gymryd rhan mewn gweithgareddau awyr agored, ac a oes unrhyw gyfle i adolygu rhywfaint o'r gwaith a ddigwyddodd yn nhymor diwethaf y Senedd ar weithgareddau awyr agored i blant mewn ysgolion.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you to the Member for raising those, and, obviously, we were also in Wrexham together on Saturday. I think that museum will hopefully not just inspire people to visit, but inspire people to be more active, to participate. I think there's much more we can do in this area, and that's why we're committed, as a Government, to be working cross-Government. Myself and the Deputy Minister for public health and prevention have already met. We will meet regularly to see how we embed this work, because it's currently not happening as it should.

I'd be very happy as well to meet with the Member to discuss how we can perhaps take forward some of the work, how it also feeds into our new strategy as well, both in terms of health, but also with the new culture strategy, and embedding those opportunities for everybody to be active, to get outdoors, to be able to participate just for fun. Because not everyone will be at the elite level representing Wales, even though some of us may dream of it. But being able to have fun as well is key there. So, I'd be very happy to take that conversation forward with you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r rheini, ac yn amlwg, roeddem yn Wrecsam gyda'n gilydd ddydd Sadwrn hefyd. Gobeithio y bydd yr amgueddfa honno nid yn unig yn ysbrydoli pobl i ymweld, ond yn ysbrydoli pobl i fod yn fwy egnïol, i gymryd rhan mewn chwaraeon. Rwy'n credu bod llawer mwy y gallwn ei wneud yn y maes hwn, a dyna pam ein bod wedi ymrwymo, fel Llywodraeth, i weithio'n drawslywodraethol. Rwyf i a'r Dirprwy Weinidog dros iechyd y cyhoedd ac atal eisoes wedi cyfarfod. Byddwn yn cyfarfod yn rheolaidd i weld sut y gallwn ymgorffori'r gwaith hwn, oherwydd nid yw'n digwydd fel y dylai ar hyn o bryd.

Buaswn yn hapus iawn hefyd i gyfarfod â'r Aelod i drafod sut y gallwn fwrw ymlaen â rhywfaint o'r gwaith, sut y mae hefyd yn bwydo i mewn i'n strategaeth newydd, o ran iechyd, ond hefyd gyda'r strategaeth ddiwylliant newydd, ac ymgorffori'r cyfleoedd hynny i bawb fod yn egnïol, i fynd allan i'r awyr agored, i allu cymryd rhan, a hynny am hwyl yn unig. Oherwydd ni fydd pawb yn cynrychioli Cymru ar y lefel elitaidd, er y gallai rhai ohonom freuddwydio am wneud hynny. Ond mae gallu cael hwyl hefyd yn allweddol. Felly, buaswn yn hapus iawn i barhau'r sgwrs honno gyda chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Fel Gweinidog newydd, dwi wedi mynd ati i geisio perthynas adeiladol gydag Undeb Rygbi Cymru, yn barod i herio pan fo angen, yn barod i gydweithio hefyd, tra'n parchu ei annibyniaeth. Mi ydym ni'n ymgysylltu'n rheolaidd ynglŷn â blaenoriaethau a rennir a datblygu'r gêm, gan gynnwys cyfranogiad, cyfleusterau, datblygu ar lawr gwlad a digwyddiadau mawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: As a new Minister, I have set about trying to build a constructive relationship with the Welsh Rugby Union, ready to challenge when that's needed, and ready to work with them, whilst also respecting their independence. We engage regularly on shared priorities and the development of the game, including participation, facilities, grass-roots development and major events.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Drefnydd. This year, the Welsh Government supported the WRU with a grant of more than £400,000 from Sport Wales this year alone, an £18 million loan and historic funding of close to £5 million over the years. That is a significant amount of taxpayers' investment in Welsh rugby, which is fantastic. Given that scale of support, can the Trefnydd confirm whether any conditions have ever been attached to that funding to safeguard the future of the Ospreys specifically, and also the future of grass-roots clubs across Swansea and Gower, who depend on a strong regional side for player pathways, as we've discussed in previous questions, coaching and community sport? Has any taxpayer money gone to the WRU with no strings attached, leaving my constituents' rugby clubs with no protection if the Ospreys are the region to go? I say that as a family member who has lost players who played for the Ospreys and they've gone over the border, and we're losing that young generation. So, I think I echo everyone on behalf of Gŵyr Abertawe, but I want to know: are there any strings attached to those loans? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Drefnydd. Eleni, darparodd Llywodraeth Cymru gefnogaeth grant o fwy na £400,000 ar gyfer y flwyddyn gyfredol yn unig gan Chwaraeon Cymru i Undeb Rygbi Cymru, ynghyd â benthyciad o £18 miliwn a chyllid hanesyddol o bron i £5 miliwn dros y blynyddoedd. Mae hwnnw'n swm sylweddol o fuddsoddiad gan drethdalwyr yn rygbi Cymru, sy'n wych. O ystyried y raddfa honno o gefnogaeth, a all y Trefnydd gadarnhau a oes unrhyw amodau wedi'u gosod ar y cyllid hwnnw er mwyn diogelu dyfodol y Gweilch yn benodol, yn ogystal â dyfodol clybiau llawr gwlad ar draws Abertawe a Gŵyr, sy'n dibynnu ar dîm rhanbarthol cryf ar gyfer llwybrau i chwaraewyr, fel rydym wedi'i drafod mewn cwestiynau blaenorol, hyfforddiant a chwaraeon cymunedol? A oes unrhyw arian trethdalwyr wedi mynd i Undeb Rygbi Cymru heb unrhyw amodau ynghlwm wrtho, gan adael clybiau rygbi fy etholwyr heb unrhyw amddiffyniad os mai'r Gweilch fydd y rhanbarth a gaiff ei ddileu? Dywedaf hynny fel aelod o deulu sydd wedi colli chwaraewyr a chwaraeai i'r Gweilch ac maent wedi mynd dros y ffin, ac rydym yn colli'r genhedlaeth ifanc honno. Felly, rwy’n credu fy mod yn adleisio barn pawb ar ran Abertawe a Gŵyr, ond rwyf am wybod: a oes unrhyw amodau ynghlwm wrth y benthyciadau hynny? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Wel, fel dwi wedi pwysleisio yn ystod y sesiwn hwn, mae'r rhain yn faterion annibynnol, a drwy Chwaraeon Cymru rydyn ni'n ariannu unrhyw gorff. Yn sicr, os oes gennych chi bryderon, mi fedraf i ofyn i Chwaraeon Cymru fod yn darparu rhagor o wybodaeth i chi. Dwi'n meddwl yr hyn sydd yn glir iawn o sesiwn heddiw ydy bod yna nifer o gwestiynau gan Aelodau ynglŷn ag Undeb Rygbi Cymru. Dwi'n awyddus iawn i gydweithio efo Aelodau ynglŷn ag unrhyw bryderon sydd gennych chi, a dwi'n hapus iawn i fod yn codi'r rhain yn uniongyrchol efo Undeb Rygbi Cymru. Pan oeddwn i'n llefarydd ar ran chwaraeon, mi oeddwn i'n ddigon parod i ofyn cwestiynau a herio hefyd, ac, fel Gweinidog, dwi'n barod iawn i wneud hynny.

Dwi'n falch iawn bod cymaint ohonoch chi yn pryderu am ddyfodol y gêm yng Nghymru gydag angerdd, ac, os cawn ni weithio gyda'n gilydd, yna dwi'n meddwl bod hwnna'n le da i ddechrau.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Well, as I have emphasised during the session, these are independent issues, and it's through Sport Wales that we fund any body. Certainly, if you do have concerns, I can ask Sport Wales to provide more information to you. I think what is very clear from today's session is that there are a number of questions from Members related to the WRU. I'm very eager to work together with Members in relation to any concerns that you have, and I'm very happy to raise these directly with the Welsh Rugby Union. When I was a sports spokesperson, I was quite prepared to ask questions and challenge as well, and, as a Minister, I'm still prepared to do that.

I'm very pleased that so many of you are worried about the future of the game in Wales with such passion, and, if we can all work together, then I think that this is a good place to start.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 1. Pa wersi y mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet wedi'u dysgu ers methu â phasio'r gyllideb atodol gyntaf ar gyfer 2026-27, a sut y bydd hyn yn llywio dull gweithredu Llywodraeth Cymru o ran cyllidebau yn y dyfodol? OQ64442
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 1. What lessons has the Cabinet Minister learnt since failing to pass the first supplementary budget for 2026-27, and how will this inform the Welsh Government's approach to future budgets? OQ64442

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
There are lessons for Government and political parties from the supplementary budget vote. In a Senedd with no overall majority, co-operation and responsible decision making are essential as we look forward to future budgets. The Government wants to engage constructively across the Senedd to ensure that budgets are a blend, as I see it, of three component parts: funding for the delivery of effective public services, funding for priorities brought into Government by Plaid Cymru, and funding for other priorities from other political parties.

In order to produce a blended budget that can command a Senedd majority, my only plea across the Chamber is that we have a common understanding also of the financial envelope available to us. We are facing the most challenging budget settlement of this decade in 2027-28, with a real-terms reduction of around 0.7 per cent in resource funding, and even greater reductions in capital budgets. The financial envelope for next year's budget is especially tight, and will require a particular discipline for this Government and for all of us who want to play a constructive part in passing Wales's annual budget.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae gwersi i’r Llywodraeth a phleidiau gwleidyddol o'r bleidlais ar y gyllideb atodol. Mewn Senedd heb fwyafrif clir, mae cydweithrediad a phenderfyniadau cyfrifol yn hanfodol wrth inni edrych ymlaen at gyllidebau’r dyfodol. Mae’r Llywodraeth eisiau ymgysylltu’n adeiladol ar draws y Senedd i sicrhau bod cyllidebau’n gyfuniad, fel y’i gwelaf, o dair rhan: cyllid ar gyfer darparu gwasanaethau cyhoeddus effeithiol, cyllid ar gyfer blaenoriaethau a ddygir i mewn i’r Llywodraeth gan Blaid Cymru, a chyllid ar gyfer blaenoriaethau eraill gan bleidiau gwleidyddol eraill.

Er mwyn llunio cyllideb gyfunol sy'n gallu sicrhau mwyafrif yn y Senedd, fy unig apêl ar draws y Siambr yw ein bod hefyd yn rhannu dealltwriaeth gyffredin o'r amlen ariannol sydd ar gael i ni. Yn 2027-28, rydym yn wynebu'r setliad cyllidebol mwyaf heriol y degawd hwn, gyda gostyngiad o tua 0.7 y cant mewn termau real mewn cyllid adnoddau, a gostyngiadau hyd yn oed yn fwy mewn cyllidebau cyfalaf. Mae'r amlen ariannol ar gyfer cyllideb y flwyddyn nesaf yn arbennig o dynn, a bydd angen disgyblaeth arbennig ar y Llywodraeth hon a phob un ohonom sydd am chwarae rhan adeiladol wrth basio cyllideb flynyddol Cymru.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Fair play, that's a fair answer, finance Minister, and thank you for giving so much information. One thing is critical: what was shown in the draft budget was that there was little dialogue of meaningful consequence with the other political parties, and hence the budget never passed. Can you confirm today whether you've begun those discussions with the political parties, or are you just in exclusive talks with a particular group in this Senedd? I appreciate the discussions are confidential, but I think it's a matter of public interest to understand exactly which parties the Government will work with and those parties you won't.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Chwarae teg, mae hwnnw'n ateb teg, Weinidog cyllid, a diolch am roi cymaint o wybodaeth. Mae un peth yn hollbwysig: yr hyn a ddangoswyd yn y gyllideb ddrafft oedd nad oedd llawer o ddeialog ystyrlon gyda'r pleidiau gwleidyddol eraill, ac felly ni chafodd y gyllideb ei phasio. A allwch chi gadarnhau heddiw eich bod wedi dechrau'r trafodaethau hynny gyda'r pleidiau gwleidyddol, neu ai gyda grŵp dethol yn y Senedd hon yn unig rydych chi’n trafod? Rwy'n deall bod y trafodaethau'n gyfrinachol, ond rwy’n credu ei bod hi o fudd i’r cyhoedd ddeall yn union pa bleidiau y bydd y Llywodraeth yn gweithio gyda nhw, a pha rai na fyddwch chi'n gweithio gyda nhw.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'm not sure whether I will always welcome a question from Andrew R.T. Davies as Cabinet Minister for Finance, but today in particular, it was particularly useful for me to see that your question, constructed in this manner, allowed me to outline some of my thoughts on how I see the future of budget discussions. And, yes, we are keen, as the First Minister has said, to have discussions with all political parties. We are very conscious of the fact that we are a minority Government. If that supplementary budget vote was useful in anything, it was useful in reminding us, as a Government, that we need to command a majority to pass any budget in this place.

So, I look to all Members here to consider our roles in a different way perhaps to how we have considered our roles and participation in budgets of the past. In fact, the Welsh Conservatives have an advantage over all other political parties here. You're almost the continuity party in this Senedd, because you are an opposition party and you've played—[Interruption.] You're consistently an opposition party; I do not prejudge the future. But Reform is a new party in this Senedd, Labour is a party in opposition for the first time and Plaid Cymru is a party in Government, and there are new roles for all of us to play in that. But I hope that as we continue discussions over the next few weeks and months—. And those discussions are happening, and I want now to use pace and to think about how we can have those discussions across political parties and individuals in this Chamber to bring ideas into this big melting pot that is the annual budget. So, I hope that we can do that in a more meaningful way than we have done coming out of the election before the summer. And I think that's a challenge that all of us have to rise to, and me, in particular, as the finance Minister.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Nid wyf yn siŵr a fyddaf bob amser yn croesawu cwestiwn gan Andrew R.T. Davies yn fy rôl fel Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid, ond heddiw yn arbennig, roedd yn ddefnyddiol iawn gweld bod eich cwestiwn, a luniwyd yn y modd hwn, wedi gadael i mi amlinellu rhai o fy syniadau ynghylch sut y gwelaf drafodaethau cyllideb yn y dyfodol. Ac rydym yn awyddus, fel y dywedodd y Prif Weinidog, i drafod gyda'r holl bleidiau gwleidyddol. Rydym yn ymwybodol iawn o'r ffaith ein bod yn Llywodraeth leiafrifol. Os oedd y bleidlais honno ar y gyllideb atodol yn ddefnyddiol o gwbl, roedd yn ddefnyddiol am iddi ein hatgoffa ni fel Llywodraeth fod angen inni sicrhau mwyafrif er mwyn pasio unrhyw gyllideb yn y siambr hon.

Felly, rwy'n gofyn i’r holl Aelodau yma ystyried ein rolau mewn ffordd sy'n wahanol efallai i'r ffordd rydym wedi ystyried ein rolau a'n cyfranogiad mewn cyllidebau yn y gorffennol. Yn wir, mae gan y Ceidwadwyr Cymreig fantais dros yr holl bleidiau gwleidyddol eraill yma. Bron nad chi yw’r blaid sy'n cynrychioli parhad yn y Senedd hon, oherwydd rydych chi'n blaid wrthblaid ac rydych chi wedi chwarae—[Torri ar draws]. Rydych chi’n blaid wrthblaid yn barhaus; nid wyf yn rhagfarnu'r dyfodol. Ond mae Reform yn blaid newydd yn y Senedd hon, mae Llafur yn blaid wrthblaid am y tro cyntaf ac mae Plaid Cymru yn blaid mewn Llywodraeth, ac mae rolau newydd i bob un ohonom eu chwarae yn hynny. Ond rwy'n gobeithio, wrth inni barhau â thrafodaethau dros yr wythnosau a'r misoedd nesaf—. Ac mae'r trafodaethau hynny'n digwydd, ac rwyf am symud yn gyflym nawr ac ystyried sut y gallwn gynnal y trafodaethau hynny ar draws y pleidiau gwleidyddol ac unigolion yn y Siambr hon i gyflwyno syniadau i bair mawr y gyllideb flynyddol. Felly, rwy'n gobeithio y gallwn wneud hynny mewn ffordd fwy ystyrlon nag y gwnaethom ers yr etholiad cyn yr haf. Ac rwy'n credu bod honno'n her y mae'n rhaid i bob un ohonom ymateb iddi, a minnau’n arbennig, fel y Gweinidog cyllid.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: During the supplementary budget process, we, at Reform, were clear that one of our key red lines was the removal of Wales's international spending commitments. Now, the finance Minister today has spoken about the challenges that lie ahead with the budget, and, over the weekend, she said that there may well be some cuts in some areas of budget, when speaking to the media. Given that cuts are clearly on the table, will the finance Minister commit today to cutting Government spending in foreign countries before she considers cutting spending in Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Yn ystod proses y gyllideb atodol, roeddem ni yn Reform yn glir mai un o'n prif linellau coch oedd dileu ymrwymiadau gwariant rhyngwladol Cymru. Heddiw, mae'r Gweinidog cyllid wedi sôn am yr heriau sy'n wynebu'r gyllideb, a thros y penwythnos, wrth siarad â'r cyfryngau, dywedodd y gallai fod toriadau mewn rhai meysydd o'r gyllideb. Gan ei bod hi'n amlwg fod toriadau’n cael eu hystyried, a wnaiff y Gweinidog cyllid ymrwymo heddiw i dorri gwariant y Llywodraeth mewn gwledydd tramor cyn iddi ystyried torri gwariant yng Nghymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I take no red lines into this budgetary process, genuinely, in terms of the work that I'm doing within Government and the need, as I outlined in my initial statement, for this Government to be disciplined in how our Ministers are looking at their portfolios. A 0.7 per cent real-terms decrease in the budget is a real challenge for the Ministers in the exercise of their portfolios. So, I take no red lines into my discussions across all budget areas. But, obviously, there are manifesto commitments and ideas that this party, Plaid Cymru, brings into Government, and I am sure, as we discuss with Members and parties across the Chamber, that we can have a frank discussion about what is possible and where our common priorities lie. So, no red lines, but an open door for discussions.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: O ddifrif, nid oes gennyf unrhyw linellau coch ar ddechrau'r broses gyllidebol hon, o ran y gwaith rwy'n ei wneud yn y Llywodraeth a'r angen, fel y nodais yn fy natganiad cychwynnol, i'r Llywodraeth hon fod yn ddisgybledig yn y ffordd y mae ein Gweinidogion yn ystyried eu portffolios. Mae gostyngiad o 0.7 y cant yn y gyllideb mewn termau real yn her wirioneddol i'r Gweinidogion wrth iddynt gyflawni eu cyfrifoldebau portffolio. Felly, nid oes gennyf unrhyw linellau coch ar ddechrau’r trafodaethau ar draws pob maes cyllideb. Ond wrth gwrs, mae yna ymrwymiadau maniffesto a syniadau y mae'r blaid hon, Plaid Cymru, yn eu dwyn i mewn i Lywodraeth, ac rwy'n hyderus, wrth inni drafod gydag Aelodau a phleidiau ar draws y Siambr, y gallwn gael trafodaeth onest am yr hyn sy'n bosibl a beth yw ein blaenoriaethau cyffredin. Felly, dim llinellau coch, ond drws agored i drafodaethau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: One of the most common things I've heard since being elected is the difficulties the public sector and third sector are facing with short-term and single-year funding. It's clear that throwing money at an issue isn't going to solve the root cause of it, and, for a long time, it felt like that was the case. After 26 years of the previous Labour administration, as we know, one in three children are still living in poverty, our waiting lists are at their highest and there's been little behavioural change in walking and cycling rates, despite the promotion of active travel—all issues that we've inherited from Labour. So, does the Cabinet Minister agree that genuine, lasting change is more likely to be delivered through long-term, sustainable funding, with clear accountability for results?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Un o'r pethau mwyaf cyffredin a glywais ers cael fy ethol yw'r anawsterau y mae'r sector cyhoeddus a'r trydydd sector yn eu hwynebu oherwydd cyllid tymor byr a chyllid un flwyddyn yn unig. Mae'n amlwg na fydd taflu arian at broblem yn datrys yr hyn sy’n ei hachosi, ac am amser hir, roedd yna deimlad mai felly roedd hi. Ar ôl 26 mlynedd o'r weinyddiaeth Lafur flaenorol, fel y gwyddom, mae un o bob tri o blant yn dal i fyw mewn tlodi, mae ein rhestrau aros ar eu lefel uchaf ac ychydig o newid ymddygiadol a fu o ran y cyfraddau sy’n cerdded a beicio, er gwaethaf hyrwyddo teithio llesol—mae’r rhain oll yn faterion rydym wedi'u hetifeddu gan Lafur. Felly, a yw'r Gweinidog Cabinet yn cytuno ei bod yn fwy tebygol y cyflawnir newid gwirioneddol a pharhaol drwy gyllid hirdymor a chynaliadwy, gyda chyfrifoldeb clir am ganlyniadau?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yes, I certainly agree that, in looking at budgets, we need not just to look at those spending lines as they are drafted on a spreadsheet, but we need to look properly at where our outcomes can be improved, and you've listed some of the areas where we need, as Wales, to be doing better, and, certainly, as a Government, we're committed to doing so. So, looking at outcomes, effectiveness and value for money all go hand in hand as we seek, as a new Government in place, in advance of making our own budget and putting it together, as we are looking at efficiencies within Government and outcomes of where we want to prioritise our funding. That piece of work is being undertaken as a budgetary process, but especially in light of our appointment of a Minister with exact responsibility for effectiveness and outcomes of Government action. And that lasting change, of course, that you spoke of, does require something that is more agile and meaningful than annual budgets—so, a commitment to looking to a multi-year budget, but, of course, within the spending review of the allocations to us as a Government. Looking to a multi-year budget is something that I'm looking to propose as part of our budget processes here.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ydw, rwy'n sicr yn cytuno, wrth edrych ar gyllidebau, fod angen inni edrych ar fwy na’r llinellau gwariant fel y cânt eu drafftio ar daenlen, a bod angen inni edrych yn iawn ar ble y gellir gwella ein canlyniadau, ac rydych chi wedi rhestru rhai o'r meysydd lle mae angen i ni, fel Cymru, wneud yn well, ac yn sicr, fel Llywodraeth, rydym wedi ymrwymo i wneud hynny. Felly, mae edrych ar ganlyniadau, effeithiolrwydd a gwerth am arian i gyd yn mynd law yn llaw wrth i ni, fel Llywodraeth newydd, cyn inni greu a llunio ein cyllideb ein hunain, ystyried arbedion effeithlonrwydd o fewn y Llywodraeth a chanlyniadau yn y meysydd lle rydym am flaenoriaethu ein cyllid. Mae'r gwaith hwnnw'n cael ei wneud fel proses gyllidebol, ond yn enwedig yng ngoleuni'r ffaith ein bod wedi penodi Gweinidog sydd â chyfrifoldeb penodol dros effeithiolrwydd a chanlyniadau gweithredu'r Llywodraeth. Ac mae'r newid parhaol y sonioch chi amdano yn galw am rywbeth sy'n fwy hyblyg ac ystyrlon na chyllidebau blynyddol—felly, ymrwymiad i ystyried cyllideb amlflwyddyn, ond o fewn fframwaith yr adolygiad o wariant o'r dyraniadau a wneir i ni fel Llywodraeth wrth gwrs. Mae edrych ar gyllideb amlflwyddyn yn rhywbeth rwy'n bwriadu ei gynnig fel rhan o'n prosesau cyllidebu yma.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mike Hedges.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mike Hedges.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you very much for calling me. I didn't know I was down for this, but—[Laughter.]—that will not stop me making some comments. I think that when we look at budgets and we look at where we are, then it's all about priorities, isn't it? You and I have different priorities. My priority is additional learning needs for children. Yours is to have a Welsh broadcasting authority. You've every right to have those different priorities, but do you understand why we have a different one?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr am fy ngalw. Wyddwn i ddim fy mod i ar y rhestr ar gyfer hyn, ond—[Chwerthin.]—ni wnaiff hynny fy atal rhag gwneud sylwadau. Wrth inni edrych ar gyllidebau ac ar y sefyllfa bresennol, rwy'n credu mai mater o flaenoriaethau yw'r cyfan, onid e? Mae gennych chi a minnau flaenoriaethau gwahanol. Fy mlaenoriaeth i yw anghenion dysgu ychwanegol i blant. Eich blaenoriaeth chi yw cael awdurdod darlledu Cymreig. Mae gennych bob hawl i gael y blaenoriaethau gwahanol hynny, ond a ydych chi'n deall pam y mae gennym ni un wahanol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I don't think we have different priorities, Mike; I think we share that priority of needing to spend more on additional learning needs. We were prepared and we voted for that in the supplementary budget. I don't think these are competing positions. We need to strike that note and work on the balances of where we can land this together. So, let's not polarise this in question No. 1 to me at the start of a budget process. Let's see if we can work together on this.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Nid wyf yn credu bod gennym ni flaenoriaethau gwahanol, Mike; rwy'n credu ein bod ni'n rhannu'r flaenoriaeth o fod angen gwario mwy ar anghenion dysgu ychwanegol. Roeddem ni'n barod ac fe wnaethom ni bleidleisio o blaid hynny yn y gyllideb atodol. Nid wyf yn credu bod y rhain yn safbwyntiau sy'n gwrthdaro. Mae angen inni fynd i'r cyfeiriad hwnnw a gweithio ar sut y gallwn ni gytuno ar y ffordd ymlaen. Felly, gadewch inni beidio â'i wneud yn fater sy'n rhannu barn yn y cwestiwn cyntaf i mi ar ddechrau proses y gyllideb. Gadewch inni weld a allwn ni gydweithio ar hyn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 2. Sut mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn defnyddio ei galluoedd ariannol i gefnogi'r diwydiant twristiaeth yng Ngheredigion Penfro? OQ64430
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 2. How is the Welsh Government using its financial levers to support the tourism industry in Ceredigion Penfro? OQ64430

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae cronfa buddsoddi twristiaeth Cymru, a mentrau eraill, yn buddsoddi bron i £60 miliwn yn uniongyrchol yng Nghymru. Mae llawer o fusnesau'n derbyn rhyddhad ardrethi annomestig neu byddant yn elwa o'r lluosydd is estynedig o 2027 ymlaen, fel y cyhoeddais i ddoe. Rŷn ni hefyd yn ymgynghori ar newidiadau posib i'r trothwy 182 diwrnod ar gyfer eiddo hunanarlwyo.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Wales tourism investment fund, and other initiatives, invest almost £60 million directly in Wales. Many businesses receive non-domestic rates relief or they will benefit from the expanded lower multiplier from 2027 onwards, as I announced yesterday. We are also consulting on potential changes to the 182-day threshold for self-catering properties.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cabinet Minister, yesterday's announcement of a 30 per cent cut in business rates for some of the smallest hospitality accommodation and leisure venues is certainly a welcome step forward. However, there is plenty more that the Welsh Government can do to support the tourism industry in Ceredigion Penfro, including reducing the devastating 182-day occupancy threshold for self-catering businesses. Now, I appreciate that the Welsh Government's consulting on this, but the consultation states that there will be a limit to the extent of any reduction in the threshold, arguing that a substantial decrease in the threshold could incentivise an oversupply of self-catering properties. In light of this, can you clarify what the Welsh Government considers to be the minimum viable occupancy threshold? And in the interests of transparency, will you commit to publishing the evidence underpinning that position, so that business owners can understand the parameters that the Welsh Government is considering in this important consultation?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog Cabinet, mae'r cyhoeddiad ddoe am ostyngiad o 30 y cant mewn ardrethi busnes i rai o'r lleoliadau lletygarwch a hamdden lleiaf yn bendant yn gam cadarnhaol i'w groesawu. Fodd bynnag, mae llawer mwy y gall Llywodraeth Cymru ei wneud i gefnogi'r diwydiant twristiaeth yng Ngheredigion Penfro, gan gynnwys lleihau'r trothwy defnydd dinistriol o 182 diwrnod ar gyfer busnesau hunanddarpar. Rwy'n deall bod Llywodraeth Cymru yn ymgynghori ar hyn, ond mae'r ymgynghoriad yn nodi y bydd cyfyngiad ar raddau unrhyw ostyngiad yn y trothwy, gan ddadlau y gallai gostyngiad sylweddol yn y trothwy annog gorgyflenwad o eiddo hunanddarpar. Yng ngoleuni hyn, a allwch chi egluro beth y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn ei ystyried yn drothwy defnydd hyfyw isaf? Ac er tryloywder, a wnewch chi ymrwymo i gyhoeddi'r dystiolaeth sy'n sail i'r safbwynt hwnnw, fel y gall perchnogion busnes ddeall y paramedrau y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn eu hystyried yn yr ymgynghoriad pwysig hwn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Wel, mae e wastad wedi bod yn rhywbeth sydd wedi bod yn bwnc trafod yn y Senedd yma, a chyda Plaid Cymru hefyd, lle mae'r pwynt yna lle mae'r cydbwysedd yn y farchnad dai yn gorwedd rhwng y stoc dai sydd ar gael i ni ar gyfer pobl i fyw ynddyn nhw, a hefyd y stoc dai sydd yna ar gyfer y sector twristiaeth a hunanarlwyo, ac mae cael y balans yna, fel nad yw un yn effeithio'n negyddol ar y llall, cael y balans yna yn gywir, yn bwysig. A dyna beth ŷn ni yn gobeithio ei gyflawni drwy ymgynghori ar hyn.

Dwi eisoes wedi trafod gyda rhai sy'n cynrychioli'r sector hunanarlwyo, sydd, yn amlwg iawn, yn credu bod y balans yn gorwedd yn is na'r 152 o ddiwrnodau yna sydd yn yr ymgynghoriad, ac rŷch chi hefyd, mae'n bosib, yn teimlo yr un fath. Dwi'n agored i gael y drafodaeth yna. Dwi'n synhwyro y bydd yr ymateb i'r ymgynghoriad yn dangos bod y sector ei hun, a'r bobl sydd yn y sector, yn meddwl bod eisiau mynd yn ddyfnach na'r hyn sydd yn yr ymgynghoriad, ond fe fydd y Llywodraeth eisiau taro'r balans cywir. Dydyn ni ddim eisiau creu bwgan arall i ni ein hunain drwy osod y trothwy yma'n rhy isel. Ond rwyf i'n awyddus ein bod ni'n cyrraedd sefyllfa lle mae'r gyfundrefn yma sydd yn effeithio ar ein sector tai ni, ond hefyd ar ein sector hunanarlwyo, ein sector twristiaeth ni, yn cyrraedd pwynt lle mae'n gallu bod yn ganlyniad parhaol wedyn i'r pwnc yma. Felly, dwi'n agored iawn i drafod gyda chi hefyd ynglŷn â sut y mae cael y canlyniad i'r ymgynghoriad yma i gyrraedd rhywle sydd yn rhywbeth sydd yn cynnal mwyafrif y gefnogaeth yn y lle yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Well, it's always been something that's been a topic of debate in this Senedd, and within Plaid Cymru too, in terms of what is that point where you're striking the balance in the housing market between the housing stock available for people to live in and also the housing stock available for the tourism and self-catering sector, and striking that balance, so that one doesn't have a negative impact on the other, getting that balance right, is important. And that is what we hope to deliver through consulting on this.

I've already had discussions with representatives of the self-catering sector, who, clearly, do believe that the balance is at a lower point than the 152 days in the consultation, and you perhaps feel the same. Now, I am open to having that discussion. I sense that the response to the consultation will demonstrate that the sector itself, and those within the sector, do believe that we need to go deeper than what's contained within the consultation, but the Government does want to strike the right balance. We don't want to create further problems for ourselves by setting this threshold too low. But I am eager that we reach a position where this system that impacts our housing sector, but also our self-catering and tourism sectors, reaches a point where it can be a permanent solution in this area. So, I'm open to discuss this with you too in terms of how we get the outcome to this consultation to reach a point that has majority support in this place.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, what financial support will you prioritise to attract visitors to Ceredigion and Pembrokeshire outside of the summer months, so that tourism can sustain year-round jobs and give young people greater opportunities to work locally?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, pa gymorth ariannol fyddwch chi'n ei flaenoriaethu i ddenu ymwelwyr i Geredigion a sir Benfro y tu hwnt i fisoedd yr haf, fel y gall twristiaeth gynnal swyddi drwy gydol y flwyddyn a rhoi mwy o gyfleoedd i bobl ifanc weithio'n lleol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: A year-round tourism economy is something that I definitely want to see, both for the constituency that we both represent, but also for Wales generally. I think we've seen significant progress on that over the last few years, but there is more to do still on that. We have our investment priorities, and looking at how we can attract tourists for an extended period of the year is part of the criteria in how we invest in that. Also, we need to make sure that the business rates system that we have, and other taxation aspects, are also ensuring that those businesses that support the hospitality sector are able to be all year round. There's no point having businesses that are only open for a particular part of the year. We need businesses that are open all year long, so that they can provide the opportunity for tourists to benefit, but also, what benefits tourists also benefits the communities they serve. So, I'm particularly hopeful that the positive sign that the Government was able to give yesterday for such a wide array of businesses that do support the tourism sector, of a 30 per cent reduction in business rates from next April, is a positive sign for the tourism sector generally that this Government backs it.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae economi twristiaeth drwy gydol y flwyddyn yn rhywbeth rwy'n bendant am ei weld, ar gyfer yr etholaeth y mae'r ddau ohonom yn ei chynrychioli, ond hefyd i Gymru yn gyffredinol. Rwy'n credu ein bod wedi gweld cynnydd sylweddol ar hynny dros y blynyddoedd diwethaf, ond mae mwy i'w wneud ar hynny o hyd. Mae gennym ein blaenoriaethau buddsoddi, ac mae edrych ar sut y gallwn ddenu twristiaid am gyfnod estynedig o'r flwyddyn yn rhan o'r meini prawf o ran y ffordd rydym yn buddsoddi yn hynny. Hefyd, mae angen inni wneud yn siŵr bod y system ardrethi busnes sydd gennym, ac agweddau eraill ar drethiant, hefyd yn sicrhau bod y busnesau hynny sy'n cefnogi'r sector lletygarwch yn gallu gweithredu drwy gydol y flwyddyn. Nid oes pwynt cael busnesau sydd ar agor am ran benodol o'r flwyddyn. Mae angen busnesau sydd ar agor drwy gydol flwyddyn, fel y gallant roi cyfle i dwristiaid elwa, ond hefyd, mae beth sydd o fudd i dwristiaid hefyd o fudd i'r cymunedau y maent yn eu gwasanaethu. Felly, rwy'n arbennig o obeithiol fod yr arwydd cadarnhaol y gallodd y Llywodraeth ei roi ddoe i amrywiaeth mor eang o fusnesau sy'n cefnogi'r sector twristiaeth, o ostyngiad o 30 y cant mewn ardrethi busnes o fis Ebrill nesaf, yn arwydd cadarnhaol i'r sector twristiaeth yn gyffredinol fod y Llywodraeth hon yn ei gefnogi.
